MY HUSBAND AND I WERE VACATIONING IN [REDACTED] ON OCTOBER 10, 2023.  AT [REDACTED] ON OCTOBER 10, 2023 MY HUSBAND GOT A CALL ON HIS CELL PHONE FROM OUR HOME ALARM COMPANY [REDACTED].  THE CALL ROUSED US FROM OUR SLEEP SO WE DID NOT GET TO THE PHONE IN TIME TO ANSWER IT BEFORE THE CALLER LEFT A MESSAGE AND HUNG UP.  MY HUSBAND GOT OUT OF BED TO SEE WHO HAD CALLED AT THAT TIME OF THE MORNING.  HE SAW THE CALL WAS FROM [REDACTED].  MY HUSBAND CALLED [REDACTED] IMMEDIATELY AND THEY INFORMED HIM THAT OUR HOUSE ALARM HAD GONE OFF DUE TO BREAKING GLASS.  THE [REDACTED] EMPLOYEE ALSO INDICATED THAT HE CALLED THE [REDACTED] SHERIFF’S OFFICE, BUT THE SHERIFF’S OFFICE REFUSED TO COME TO THE HOME UNLESS THEY HAD A VIDEO OF GLASS ACTUALLY BREAKING AT THE HOUSE OR SOMEONE IN THE HOUSE THAT WITNESSED THE BREAKING GLASS.  THE [REDACTED] SHERIFF REPRESENTATIVE TOLD [REDACTED] THEY GET TOO MANY FALSE ALARMS SO UNLESS THERE WAS PROOF, THEY WOULD NOT RESPOND TO THE ALARM.  MY HUSBAND HANDED THE PHONE TO ME SO I COULD TALK TO THE [REDACTED] EMPLOYEE.  I ASKED THE [REDACTED] EMPLOYEE WHAT NUMBER THEY HAD CALLED TO CONTACT THE [REDACTED] SHERIFF’S OFFICE.  THEY INDICATED THEY HAD CALLED [REDACTED].  I HUNG UP AND IMMEDIATELY CALLED THE NUMBER I HAD BEEN GIVEN FOR THE [REDACTED] SHERIFF’S OFFICE.  I EXPLAINED TO THE DISPATCHER THAT [REDACTED] HAD CALLED AND THE [REDACTED] SHERIFF’S OFFICE INDICATED THEY WOULD NOT RESPOND TO THE ALARM.  I INFORMED HER THAT WE WERE VACATIONING IN [REDACTED] AND HAD NO WAY TO DETERMINE IF SOMEONE WAS RANSACKING OUR HOME.  SHE DECIDED TO DISPATCH A DEPUTY TO OUR HOME.  THE DISPATCHER TOLD ME SHE HAD A DEPUTY ENROUTE.  AT [REDACTED] AM, I GOT A CALL FROM DEPUTY [REDACTED] HE INFORMED ME HE WAS ENROUTE TO OUR HOME AND ASKED ME SOME QUESTIONS CONCERNING VIDEOS OR IF WE HAD CAMERAS INSTALLED ON THE HOUSE.  I TOLD HIM WE DID NOT HAVE CAMERAS.  HE SAID HE WOULD GO TO OUR HOME AND TAKE A LOOK AROUND.  AT [REDACTED] AM I RECEIVED ANOTHER CALL FROM DEPUTY [REDACTED].  HE INDICATED WE HAVE A LOCKED GATE THAT PROVIDES ACCESS TO OUR FENCED BACKYARD.  HE ASKED IF THERE WAS A BACK TRAIL INTO THE PROPERTY AND I INFORMED HIM THAT THE ENTIRE BACK YARD IS FENCED, AND THERE WERE TWO PADLOCKED GATES, ONE IN THE FRONT AND ONE IN THE BACK.  HE TOLD ME HE WOULD TRY TO SEE IF HE COULD GET OVER THE FENCE.  DEPUTY [REDACTED] CALLED MY BACK AT [REDACTED] AM AND INFORMED ME HE MIGHT BE ABLE TO CLIMB THE FENCE, BUT HE HAD NO CONFIDENCE HE WOULD BE ABLE TO GET BACK OUT TO THE BACKYARD ONCE HE HAD ENTERED IT.  DEPUTY [REDACTED] ASKED ME IF ANYONE HAD A KEY TO THE GATE.  I TOLD HIM MY DAUGHTER DID AND THAT I COULD CALL HER BUT IT WOULD TAKE AT LEAST 20 MINUTES FOR HER TO ARRIVE WITH THE KEY.  IN THE MEANTIME, I INDICATED I WAS VERY STRESSED ABOUT SOMEONE POSSIBLY BEING INSIDE RANSACKING MY HOUSE WHILE WE WAITED FOR MY DAUGHTER TO SHOW UP.  HE ASKED IF HE COULD HAVE MY PERMISSION TO USE BOLT CUTTERS ON THE LOCK.  I SAID YES.  DEPUTY [REDACTED] CUT THE LOCK ON THE GATE AND PROCEEDED INTO THE BACKYARD.  DEPUTY[REDACTED]  CALLED BACK AT [REDACTED]  AM INDICATING HE HAD CHECKED ALL THE WINDOWS AND THE SLIDING GLASS DOOR AND FOUND NOTHING UNUSUAL. 
MY HUSBAND AND I WERE DISTRAUGHT.  WHY WOULD OUR GLASS-BREAK HOME ALARM GO OFF FOR NO REASON?  WE HAVE HAD THE ALARM SYSTEM FOR OVER 20 YEARS AND THIS HAS NEVER HAPPENED. WE KNEW THAT THE ALARM COULD NOT BE RESET UNLESS WE WERE IN THE HOME TO DO IT.  WE REASONED THAT IF SOMEONE TRIED TO BREAK THE GLASS AND THE ALARM WENT OFF, THEY MOST LIKELY EVACUATED THE PREMISES, KNOWING THAT IF NO ONE WAS HOME, THE ALARM WOULD NOT GO OFF IF ANOTHER BREAK-IN WAS ATTEMPTED.  I CALLED [REDACTED] AT 2:00 AM AND EXPLAINED OUR SITUATION AND ASKED IF THERE WAS ANY WAY FOR US TO CUT SHORT OUR WEEK-LONG TRIP AND GET A FLIGHT HOME AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.  [REDACTED] GOT US ON [REDACTED].  THE EXPEDITED FLIGHT HOME WOULD COST US AN ADDITIONAL $470.79 FOR EACH TICKET TO GET ON THAT FLIGHT FOR A TOTAL OF $941.58.  THIS IS IN ADDITION TO THE ORIGINAL $760.40 WE PAID FOR OUR ORIGINAL ROUND-TRIP TICKETS. I HAVE ATTACHED RECEIPTS FOR THE ADDITIONAL COST.  WE WERE JUST SICK ALL DAY WONDERING IF SOMEONE WAS GOING TO BREAK IN AND HAVE FREE REIN BECAUSE THEY KNEW THERE WAS NO LONGER AN ALARM.  WE GOT TO THE [REDACTED] AIRPORT AROUND [REDACTED] PM AND GOT OUR BAGGAGE FROM BAGGAGE CLAIM AND PROCEEDED TO THE VAN PICK-UP AREA.  WE GOT TO [REDACTED] AROUND [REDACTED] PM.  WE LOADED OUR CAR AND PROCEEDED ON THE HOUR AND A HALF JOURNEY HOME.  THE WHOLE WAY HOME WE DISCUSSED WHAT WE WOULD DO IF WE ENCOUNTERED SOMEONE IN OUR HOME WHEN WE GOT THERE IN THE DARK OF NIGHT.  WHEN WE GOT HOME, I TOLD MY HUSBAND I WAS TOO DISTRAUGHT TO ENTER THE HOUSE.  HE TOLD ME TO LEAVE THE CAR RUNNING AND THE LIGHTS ON AND HE WOULD GO INSIDE TO INVESTIGATE.  MY HUSBAND CAME OUT A FEW MINUTES LATER INDICATING EVERYTHING LOOKED NORMAL.  BUT WHAT MADE THE ALARM GO OFF?  WE SPENT A SLEEPLESS NIGHT JUST WAITING FOR SOMEONE TO ATTEMPT ANOTHER BREAK-IN.  NO ONE DID.  THE NEXT MORNING, WE SEARCHED ALL OVER FOR WHAT COULD HAVE CAUSED THE ALARM TO GO OFF.  WE FOUND NOTHING.  ON OCTOBER 11, 2023 AROUND [REDACTED] PM, MY HUSBAND WAS GOING TO GET A CAN OF TOMATOES OUT OF THE PANTRY AND START DINNER.  WHEN HE LOOKED IN THE PANTRY, HE NOTICED ONE OF THE WESTERN RED BREWING POWDER WEDGE PORTER BEER CANS HAD EXPLODED IN THE CUPBOARD.  THIS EXPLOSION TOOK PLACE IN THE PANTRY AND THE ALARM SENSOR FOR BREAKING GLASS IS ON THE SAME WALL.  WE REALIZED THAT THE EXPLODING BEER CAN WAS THE CAUSE OF THE ALARM BEING TRIPPED.  MY HUSBAND NOTICED THAT THERE WERE A FEW OTHER BEER CANS THAT LOOKED SWOLLEN AND MISSHAPEN.  HE GOT THEM OUT OF THE CUPBOARD AND HANDED THEM TO ME.  I PUT THE THREE CANS IN THE KITCHEN SINK.  I OPENED THE POP TOP ON THE FIRST SWOLLEN CAN AND DRAINED THE BEER DOWN THE SINK.  WHEN I STARTED TO OPEN THE POP TOP ON THE NEXT BEER, IT EXPLODED LIKE A BOMB IN MY HAND.  BLOOD AND DARK PORTER BEER WERE SPLATTERED ALL OVER MY KITCHEN CEILING, WALLS, APPLIANCES, AND FLOOR.  I NOTICED A LOT OF BLOOD COMING FROM THE CUTS ON MY HAND AND TRIED TO PUT PRESSURE ON THEM TO STOP THE BLEEDING.  IT DID NOT WORK.  WE DECIDED TO GET IN THE CAR AND DRIVE TO THE [REDACTED].  I WENT INSIDE AND WAS TAKEN TO THE BACK.  THE DOCTOR CLEANED OUT THE INJURED FINGERS AND STITCHED THEM CLOSED.  WE DROVE BACK HOME AND MY HUSBAND BEGAN CLEANING UP THE HORRIBLE MESS.  MY HUSBAND FOUND ANOTHER CAN OF THIS BEER IN OUR REFRIGERATOR, AND PUT IT OUT ON THE PATIO.  IT EXPLODED THE NEXT DAY.
THE NEXT MORNING AT [REDACTED] AM I CONTACTED WESTERN RED BREWERY IN POULSBO, WASHINGTON TO INFORM THEM OF THE EXPLODING BEER CAN ISSUE.  I HAVE ATTACHED THE [REDACTED] CONVERSATION.  WESTERN RED BREWERY ASKED WHERE I PURCHASED THE BEER (TOTAL WINE IN [REDACTED]) AND INDICATED THEY WOULD SEND THEIR SALES REPRESENTATIVE OUT TO TOTAL WINE TO TALK TO THEM ABOUT HAVING EXPIRED PRODUCT ON THE SHELF.  I EXPRESSED MY FEAR TO WESTERN RED BREWING THAT MORE OF THIS EXPLODING BEER COULD BE ON SHELVES IN MANY RETAIL OUTLETS AND I ASKED HOW THEY WERE GOING TO AMELIORATE THIS PROBLEM.  I DID NOT HEAR BACK FROM WESTERN RED BREWING.  I CALLED ATTORNEY [REDACTED] SHE INDICATED THAT SHE NEEDED TO MAKE SURE WESTERN RED BREWERY WAS NOT A CLIENT OF THEIR POULSBO OFFICE BEFORE SHE COULD TALK TO ME.  SHE CALLED BACK AND ASSURED ME WESTERN RED BREWING WAS NOT ONE OF THEIR CLIENTS.  I WENT OVER THE ENTIRE STORY INCLUDING ALL THE DETAILS FROM THE VERY BEGINNING.  [REDACTED] TOLD ME SHE HAD TO TALK WITH ONE OF HER COLLEAGUES TO DETERMINE IF THERE WAS ACTION I COULD TAKE TO MANDATE WESTERN RED BREWING TO ISSUE A WARNING TO THEIR VENDORS AND CUSTOMERS OF THE EXTREMELY DANGEROUS SITUATION WITH THEIR POWDER WEDGE PORTER BEER, CLEAN OUT ALL REMAINING BEER FROM THE BAD BATCH, AND COVER MY ADDITIONAL AIRLINE COSTS.  [REDACTED] CALLED ME BACK AND TOLD ME SHE HAD MADE AN ERROR AND THAT WESTERN RED BREWING WAS ONE OF THEIR CLIENTS SO SHE COULD NOT TAKE MY CASE.  I MESSAGED WESTERN RED BREWING AND ASKED THEM TO PROVIDE THE MANUFACTURE DATE AND EXPIRATION DATE OF THE BEER IN ADDITION TO PROVIDING A LIST OF THE RETAIL OUTLETS THEY HAD SOLD THE BEER TO.  WESTERN RED BREWING GOT BACK TO ME AND INDICATED THEY HAD BEEN ADVISED TO SEND MY QUESTIONS OVER TO THEIR INSURANCE CARRIER.  THEY ASKED FOR MY CONTACT INFORMATION AND I GAVE THEM MY NAME AND EMAIL ADDRESS.  I HAVE TRIED REACHING OUT TO WESTERN RED BREWING MULTIPLE TIMES SINCE, AND THEY ARE NOT ANSWERING.  I AM VERY CONCERNED ABOUT OTHERS THAT MAY BE IN IMMINENT DANGER FROM THESE EXPLODING CANS.  THE ACCIDENT I HAD COULD HAVE BEEN MUCH WORSE.  IT WILL BE WORSE FOR SOME OTHER UNSUSPECTING CUSTOMER OR RETAILER.  WESTERN RED BREWING SHOULD BE MANDATED TO ISSUE AN URGENT STATEMENT NOTIFYING CUSTOMERS AND RETAILERS OF THIS HORRIFIC ISSUE.  AS A SIDE NOTE, I PURCHASED THE WESTERN RED BREWERY POWDER WEDGE PORTER BEER FROM TOTAL WINE IN [REDACTED] ON AUGUST 22, 2023.  I PUT TWO CANS IN THE REFRIGERATOR, AND FOUR IN THE PANTRY.  THE CANS BEGAN EXPLODING ON OCTOBER 10, 2023.  I CALLED TOTAL WINE ON OCTOBER 19 AND SPOKE WITH MANAGER [REDACTED] (NO LAST NAME PROVIDED).  I TOLD HER THE WHOLE STORY AND SHE APOLOGIZED AND OFFERED TO REFUND MY MONEY.  I EXPLAINED THAT WOULD BE FINE, BUT THE BIGGER ISSUE IS TO GET THAT EXPLODING BEER DESTROYED AND TO NOTIFY CUSTOMERS WHO PURCHASED IT OF THE IMMEDIATE DANGER.  SHE TOLD ME SHE THOUGHT THEY MIGHT HAVE GOTTEN RID OF THE BEER THEY HAD.  I AM NOT CONFIDENT IN HER ANSWER AND FEAR SOMEONE ELSE IS IN GRAVE DANGER.  PLEASE HELP ME TO GET THIS RESOLVED.  I AM NOT SLEEPING BECAUSE I AM WORRIED ABOUT PEOPLE GETTING HURT FOR NO REASON.  ESPECIALLY WHEN WESTERN RED BREWING COULD DO SOME RESEARCH AND LOCATE THE DANGEROUS BEER CANS AND GET THIS RESOLVED.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR IMMEDIATE ATTENTION TO THIS MATTER.

AFTER ALLOWING THE OVEN TO PRE-HEAT, THE FOOD WAS INSERTED. TWO TO THREE MINUTES AFTER INSERTING THE FOOD, THE HOUSE FILLED WITH SMOKE RELEASED FROM THE BURNING FOOD IN THE INTERIOR OF THE OVEN. WHILE OBSERVING THE OVEN COOKING THE FOOD, THE BREAD BEGAN TO OVERHEAT WITHIN A MINUTE AFTER CLOSING THE DOOR. I REMOVED THE FOOD BEFORE IT BEGAN TO BURN. THE AMBIENT HEAT FROM WITHIN THE OVEN FELT MUCH HIGHER THAN USUAL.  IT APPEARED THAT THE BROILER ELEMENT WAS RED-HOT AND MAY HAVE BEEN STUCK IN THE ON POSITION WHICH CAUSED THE FOOD TO OVERHEAT. IT APPEARS THAT THIS CAUSED THE INSIDE OF OVEN TO REACH A MUCH HIGHER TEMPERATURE THAN THE 350 F. WHICH WAS REPORTED ON THE CONTROL PANEL. THE PRODUCT DOCUMENTATION INDICATES THAT THE BROILER ELEMENT IS USED DURING THE PRE-HEATING CYCLE AND SHOULD TURN OFF AFTER THE OVEN HAS COME UP TO TEMPERATURE. THE BROILER ELEMENT REMAINING ON LEADS ME TO BELIEVE THAT THE PRODUCT FAILED TO SWITCH OFF THE ELEMENT AFTER THE PRE-HEAT CYCLE AND CAUSED IT TO OVERHEAT. MY SAFETY CONCERN IS THAT THE PRODUCT FAILED IN AN UNSAFE CONFIGURATION AND THE TEMPERATURES INSIDE THE OVEN WERE MUCH HIGHER THAN THE REPORTED 350 F.

I BOUGHT A NEW SAMSUNG REFRIGERATOR ON 5/26/24 AND IT WAS DELIVERED ON 5/31/24 (MODEL# RF23BB86004MAA - 04 AND SERIAL NUMBER 1HM643AX300041L). SINCE 9/1/24 WE HAVE BEEN HAVING ISSUES WITH THE FRIDGE NOT MAKING ICE CUBES. 

I CONTACTED SAMSUNG FOR THE FIRST TIME ON 9/10/24 FOR HELP AND I WAS DIRECTED TO READ THE MANUAL AND SINCE WE HAVE REVERSE OSMOSIS FILTERS, I WAS TOLD THAT THE LACK OF WATER PRESSURE WAS DUE TO OUR FILTER. I CALLED THE REVERSE OSMOSIS INSTALLER, AND THEY CAME TO THE HOUSE AND CHECKED THE WATER PRESSURE AND THE PRESSURE FROM THE FILTERS TO THE FRIDGE WAS CORRECT. ON 9/18/24 I CALLED SAMSUNG AGAIN AND THIS TIME I WAS RECOMMENDED TO BUY SAMSUNG DA67-02270A CAP-SUPPORT FILTER. I BOUGHT THE CAPS AND WAITED OVER A WEEK TO RECEIVE THEM. I RECEIVED THEM AROUND FRIDAY SEPTEMBER 27TH. THE CAPS DIDN'T FIT OUR UNIT (THE CAPS ARE NOT MADE FOR OUR FRIDGE MODEL). I DECIDED TO GO BUY A FRIDGE WATER FILTER AND INSTALL IT WITH THE HOPE THAT THE FRIDGE MADE ICE. THAT WEEKEND WE WENT OUT OF TOWN AND CAME BACK SUNDAY 29TH AND THE FREEZER HAD DEFROSTED, AND THE FRIDGE TOP PART WAS IN THE MID 60'S, BUT THE PANEL WAS SHOWING THAT THE INSIDE TEMPERATURE WAS 36 DEGREES. WE HAD TO THROW AWAY ALL THE FOOD THAT WENT BAD. MY SON RECEIVED A LIVER TRANSPLANT IN AUGUST, AND HE NEEDS TO KEEP HIS MEDICATIONS AND INSULIN REFRIGERATED AND WE HAD TO DISPOSE OF THOSE AS WELL.
I CONTACTED SAMSUN AGAIN MONDAY 30TH. SAMSUNG SENT A CONTRACTOR ON TUESDAY OCTOBER 1ST TO MAKE A DIAGNOSTIC OF THE ISSUE. THE TECHNICIAN FOUND THAT THE EVAPORATOR AND CONDENSER WERE NOT WORKING. SAMSUNG ORDERED THOSE PARTS AND ON WEDNESDAY OCTOBER 9TH THE CONTRACTOR CAME BACK TO THE HOUSE TO INSTALL THE NEW PARTS. 
BY THURSDAY OCTOBER 10TH EVENING, WE REALIZED THAT THE FRIDGE WAS AGAIN NOT HOLDING THE TEMPERATURE IN THE FREEZER. BY FRIDAY OCTOBER 11TH MORNING, THE TOP PART OF THE FREEZER WASNT WORKING AND AGAIN I CONTACTED SAMSUNG. 
 SAMSUNG SENT THE CONTRACTOR AGAIN TO OUR HOME MONDAY 14TH TO HAVE A VIDEO CONFERENCE WITH SAMSUNG TECHNICAL SUPPORT. THE TECHNICIAN TOLD ME THAT HE WASNT THERE TO MAKE ANY DIAGNOSTIC OR TO FIX ANYTHING, BUT ONLY TO FOLLOW THE SAMSUNG TECHNICAL SUPPORT ON WHATEVER THEY WANTED TO SEE. THE TECHNICAL SUPPORT PERSON TOLD THE CONTRACTOR THAT THIS WAS A HIGH RISK CLAIM AND TO CLOSE THE TICKET. THATS ALL I HEARD. I HAVE BEEN TRYING TO GET IN TOUCH WITH SAMSUNG SINCE YESTERDAY TO NO AVAIL. NO ONE IS TELLING ME WHETHER THE FRIDGE WILL BE FIXED OR REPLACED. AS OF NOW, THE FRIDGE PANEL SHOWS THE TOP TEMPERATURE TO BE 36 DEGREES AND THE FREEZER TEMPERATURES TO BE 0 DEGREES. BOTH TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE HIGH 70'S.

I OWN A GE PROFILE ICE MAKER, MODEL UNC15NJII. THAT'S THE MODEL NUMBER ON THE RECEIPT, BUT THE MODEL PLATE INSIDE THE UNIT SAYS UNC15NJBII. I BOUGHT IT IN APRIL 2020 FROM HOME DEPOT. IT IS A BUILT-IN ICE MAKER INSTALLED UNDER AN ISLAND IN OUR KITCHEN AND IS REGULARLY CLEANED AND THE ICE IS USED FOR CONSUMPTION ALL THE TIME.

ON SEP 25TH 2024 I DID A ROUTINE CLEANING AND NOTICED A FINE GRAY SUBSTANCE IN THE BOTTOM OF THE ICE BIN AND ALONG THE LIP THAT THE ICE SLIDES OVER AS IT IS PRODUCED. AT FIRST I THOUGHT THIS WAS MOLD OR SIMILAR, AND SCRUBBED IT UP WITH AN ABRASIVE SPONGE AND PAPER TOWELS. I COULD NOT GET ALL OF THE GRAY MATERIAL OFF THE BIN; THERE IS STILL A "STAIN" OF A GRAY LINE RUNNING AROUND THE PERIMETER OF THE BIN NEAR THE BOTTOM. HOWEVER WHEN I RESTARTED THE ICE MAKER AND OBSERVED THE FIRST PIECES OF ICE FALLING FROM THE HOPPER, I NOTICED BLACK MATERIAL SUSPENDED IN THE ICE NUGGETS. I ASSUMED AGAIN THIS WAS MOLD THAT MAY HAVE SOMEHOW MADE ITS WAY INTO THE MACHINE. I UNPLUGGED THE MACHINE TO TRY TO FURTHER INVESTIGATE. WHEN THAT ICE MELTED, I WIPED UP THE BLACK STUFF, AND REALIZED ON MY PAPER TOWEL THAT IT WAS SPARKLING LIKE SOME KIND OF METAL. I GOT A MAGNET AND CONFIRMED IT WAS METAL SHAVINGS. SIMILARLY, THE VERY FINE GRAY MATERIAL THAT I HAD ON A PAPER TOWEL WAS ALSO MAGNETIC IN NATURE. 

I TESTED THIS MYSELF SEVERAL TIMES. WHEN STARTING THE ICE MAKER WITH AN EMPTY BIN FROM AN EMPTY TANK, THE FIRST ICE WILL HAVE THE MOST COARSE SHAVINGS, AND PROGRESSIVELY THE ICE GETS MORE CLEAR, WITH THE WORSE ICE SETTLING TO THE BOTTOM OF THE BIN WHERE PEOPLE ARE LESS LIKELY TO SCOOP IT IN MOST SITUATIONS. HOWEVER, THE VERY FINE GRAY METALLIC POWDER DID COAT THE ENTIRE BIN, WHICH MAKES ME SUSPECT THAT THE METAL IS ALWAYS PRESENT, JUST TO DIFFERENT DEGREES OF FINENESS.

IT IS NOT CLEAR FOR HOW LONG THIS ICE MAKER HAS BEEN EMBEDDING METAL IN THE ICE, WHETHER COARSE OR FINE, BUT IT WAS AN ALARMING DISCOVERY. THE ICE AUGER ASSEMBLY IS SEALED AND I DIDN'T WANT TO POP IT OPEN AND VOID MY WARRANTY. SO I CONTACTED GE, WHO TOLD ME IT WAS OUT OF WARRANTY FOR THIS TYPE OF FAILURE, BUT THAT THEY'D SEND SOMEONE TO LOOK AT IT FOR FREE AS IT WAS CONSIDERED A SAFETY ISSUE. THE FOLLOWING MONDAY, A TECH FROM A LOCAL AUTHORIZED GE SERVICER ([REDACTED] APPLIANCE) CAME BY AND REPRODUCED THE ISSUE HIMSELF, AGAIN USING A MAGNET TO OBSERVE THE METAL SHAVINGS THAT WERE EMBEDDED IN THE ICE.

AFTER THE TECH LEFT, HE SPOKE TO GE WHO ADVISED THAT HE WOULD NEED TO REPLACE SEVERAL PARTS IN THE MACHINE AT MY EXPENSE. THE PARTS ALONE WERE ALMOST $3,000, NEARLY THE COST OF A NEW UNIT, AND THE TECH SUGGESTED I PURSUE A CLAIM THROUGH MY HOME DEPOT EXTENDED WARRANTY INSTEAD. IN THE MEANTIME I CONTACTED GE'S SOCIAL MEDIA TO LET THEM KNOW ABOUT THE ISSUE, WITH PHOTOS AND VIDEOS. GE'S SOCIAL MEDIA TEAM OFFERED ME A $400 COUPON TO HELP RECOVER SOME OF THE PARTS COST. I REFUSED THAT, AND INSISTED IT WAS A SERIOUS SAFETY ISSUE THAT SHOULD BE INVESTIGATED. ULTIMATELY, THEY HAVE AGREED TO REPLACE THE UNIT WITH A SLIGHTLY NEWER REVISION. HOWEVER I DO NOT KNOW WHETHER THE NEW UNIT HAS CHANGED ANYTHING ABOUT THE DESIGN, AND I'M VERY CONCERNED THAT GE PROFILE ICE MAKERS MAY HAVE A DESIGN FLAW THAT IS RESULTING IN THE WIDESPREAD CONSUMPTION OF METAL PARTICULATE IN WATER ICE.

I CANNOT SAY FOR CERTAIN WHETHER DIRECT INJURY HAS OCCURRED. I DID GET AN MRI RECENTLY AND, AS FAR AS I KNOW, MY STOMACH DIDN'T EXPLODE WITH SHRAPNEL, BUT I'M GENUINELY CONCERNED FOR ANYONE WHO MAY CONSUME THE FIRST ICE OF A BATCH WHEN THE SHAVINGS SEEM TO BE MORE COARSE. I ALSO SUSPECT THAT MACHINES THAT HAVE BEEN IN SERVICE FOR LONGER MAY WELL SHOW SIGNIFICANTLY MORE WEAR TO THE INTERNAL ASSEMBLIES AND THUS MORE METAL MAY BE PRESENT.

incident_description: I GOT AN ELECTRIC SHOCK FROM A LIGHT FIXTURE THAT HAS A DESIGN FLAW THAT RESULTS IN THE MAINS VOLTAGE BEING EXPOSED IN A PLACE WHERE YOU CAN EASILY TOUCH IT. THE FIXTURE IS A SWING-ARM SCONCE, AND I HAVE TWO OF THEM MOUNTED ON EITHER SIDE OF MY BED. THE DIMMER KNOB WORKS BY RAISING THE VOLTAGE OF THE NEUTRAL LEAD THAT IS CONNECTED TO THE OUTSIDE OF THE LIGHT BULB. AND THE LIGHT BULB, WHEN FULLY SCREWED INTO THE SOCKET, HAS THE OUTSIDE METAL PART OF THE BULB BASE STILL STICKING UP A BIT ABOVE THE SOCKET. WHEN THE LIGHT IS FULLY BRIGHT (NO DIMMER), THE OUTSIDE OF THE LIGHT BULB IS AT 0 V. AS YOU DIM THE LIGHT TO ZERO, THE OUTSIDE OF THE LIGHT GOES UP TO 120 V. WHEN REACHING UP TO USE THE LIGHT, I INADVERTENTLY TOUCHED THE OUTSIDE METAL OF THE BULB WITH MY FINGERTIP AND GOT A NASTY SHOCK ON MY FINGER, AND I FELT THE CURRENT COME OUT OF MY FOOT, WHICH WAS IN CONTACT WITH THE FLOOR. I TOOK OUT MY MULTIMETER AND FOUND THAT THE OUTSIDE OF THE BULB WAS AT 100 V AT THE TIME. I CALLED OUT AN ELECTRICIAN WHO DETERMINED THAT THE FAULT IS DUE TO THE DESIGN OF THE FIXTURE ITSELF. THERE IS A LITTLE CARDBOARD SLEEVE AROUND THE SOCKET, BUT IT DOES NOT STICK UP HIGH ENOUGH TO PROTECT THE METAL OUTSIDE OF THE LIGHT BULB. (ALSO, THAT WOULD STILL BE A TERRIBLE DESIGN CHOICE.) THE PRODUCT IS THE VISUAL COMFORT S-2000. HTTPS://WWW.VISUALCOMFORT.COM/TRIPLE-SWING-ARM-WALL-LAMP-S2000/

INTRODUCTION
AT PRECISELY 7 AM ON A SEEMINGLY SERENE SUNDAY MORNING, AN UNUSUAL AND ALARMING OCCURRENCE SHATTERED THE PEACEFUL ATMOSPHERE OF MY HOUSEHOLD. WHILE THE MAJORITY OF MY FAMILY ENJOYED THE BLISSFUL SLUMBER THAT ONLY A WEEKEND CAN PROVIDE, MY YOUNGEST SON AND I WERE JOLTED AWAKE BY A THUNDEROUS EXPLOSION EMANATING FROM THE KITCHEN. THIS REPORT CHRONICLES THE EVENTS THAT UNFOLDED AND THE SUBSEQUENT IMPLICATIONS ON OUR CULINARY ENDEAVORS.THE INCIDENT
UPON HEARING THE DEAFENING BANG, MY SON AND I EXCHANGED BEWILDERED GLANCES THAT COULD ONLY BE INTERPRETED AS A SHARED UNDERSTANDING OF IMPENDING CHAOS. WE RACED TO THE KITCHEN, ADRENALINE PUMPING, ONLY TO DISCOVER THAT OUR FRIGIDAIRE GLASS STOVE DOOR HAD SPONTANEOUSLY SHATTERED INTO A MILLION GLITTERING PIECES. REMARKABLY, THE STOVE WAS OFF, UNUTILIZED, AND DECIDEDLY COOL TO THE TOUCH. INVESTIGATING THE PHENOMENON
IN MY QUEST FOR ANSWERS, I TURNED TO THE ALL-KNOWING ENTITY WE CALL THE INTERNET. MUCH TO MY ASTONISHMENT, I UNCOVERED A NATIONWIDE TREND: THE FRIGIDAIRE GLASS STOVE DOORS WERE APPARENTLY REVOLTING AGAINST THEIR MUNDANE EXISTENCE. REPORTS INDICATED THAT THESE DOORS WERE SHATTERING LIKE THEY WERE AUDITIONING FOR A ROLE IN A DRAMATIC FILM, LEAVING COUNTLESS FAMILIES IN A STATE OF CULINARY DISARRAY. THE DIET DILEMMA
WHILE ONE MIGHT SURMISE THAT A SPONTANEOUS KITCHEN EXPLOSION COULD SERVE AS A DIVINE INTERVENTION IN MY ONGOING BATTLE WITH WEIGHT, I MUST FIRMLY REJECT THE NOTION THAT MY APPLIANCES SHOULD TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDSOR, IN THIS CASE, GLASS SHARDS. AS I EMBARK ON MY JOURNEY TO REPLACE THE STOVE DOOR, I AM FACED WITH THE PRESSING ISSUE OF HOW TO FEED A FAMILY OF SIX WITHOUT THE LUXURY OF A FUNCTIONING STOVE.ALTERNATIVE CULINARY SOLUTIONS
IN LIGHT OF THIS UNEXPECTED PREDICAMENT, I PROPOSE THE FOLLOWING STRATEGIES TO KEEP MY FAMILY NOURISHED:MICROWAVE MARVELS: THE TRUSTY MICROWAVE STANDS READY TO ASSIST. WHO KNEW THAT LETTUCE COULD BE SO VERSATILE? COLD SANDWICHES: THE CLASSIC SANDWICH REIGNS SUPREME. CERTAIN TYPES OF FILAMENT REQUIRE HOT AIR AROUND THEM TO PRINT PROPERLY. TO ACCOMPLISH THIS THE USER PROGRAMS THE PRINTER TURN ON IT'S "CHAMBER HEATER." AS THE AIR INSIDE THE PRINTER GETS WARM, THE ELECTRONICS THAT CONTROL THE HEATER FAIL TO ADEQUATELY CONTROL THE ELECTRIC CURRENT AND THE CIRCUIT BOARD BECOMES HOT ENOUGH TO IGNITE. 
THE MODEL THAT I OWN NEARLY CAUGHT FIRE AS I WAS OVERSEEING IT OPERATE.  
I THEN RESEARCHED THE ISSUE AND FOUND MANY OTHER CONSUMERS WERE EXPERIENCING THE SAME ISSUE. 
THERE ARE MANY POSTS AND A FEW YOUTUBE VIDEOS BY EXPERIENCED CREATORS THAT ATTEST TO THIS ISSUE. 
QIDI HAS KNOWN THIS ISSUE WELL OVER A WEEK NOW. THEY INSTRUCTED THEIR CUSTOMERS TO UPDATE THE FIRMWARE IN AN ATTEMPT TO MITIGATE THE RISE IN TEMPERATURE BUT ASTUTE CUSTOMERS REBUKED THIS ATTEMPT WITH PROOF THAT THE FIRMWARE UPDATE IS NOT SUFFICIENT TO LESSEN THE RISK OF FIRE. HARDWARE COMPONENTS MUST BE REPLACED WITH SAFER ONES TO ADEQUATELY REDUCE THE TEMPERATURE RISE ON THE CIRCUIT BOARD. 
SEVERAL CONSUMERS IN THE QIDI MESSAGE BOARDS HAVE OFFERED "FIXES" TO THIS PROBLEM BY SUGGESTING THE PROPER COMPONENTS & DIRECTIONS TO REPLACE THE FAULTY ONES. *THIS IS A VERY RISKY PROCESS FOR THOSE UNFAMILIAR WITH WORKING ON AC CURRENT SYSTEMS!*
A WIDESPREAD, COMPREHENSIVE RECALL NEEDS TO BE INITIATED BY QIDI TECH AT QIDI TECH'S COST.

THE STEM EXTENDING FROM THE RANGE IS METAL.  AS THE RANGE STEM IS STEEL, IT GETS VERY HOT WHILE USING THE STOVE CAUSING THE PLASTIC KNOB STEM TO SPLAY/STRIP/MELT DUE TO HEAT.  I CONTACTED ABT WHILE THE RANGE WAS UNDER WARRANTY AND NEW KNOBS WERE SENT.  HOWEVER, THE NEW KNOBS ALSO HAD PLASTIC STEMS WHICH SUBSEQUENTLY MELTED AND SPLAYED CAUSING THE SAME ISSUE. I HAVE SPENT HOURS ON THE PHONE.  I CONTACTED THE JENNAIR SAFETY DEPARTMENT AND I WAS SENT ONE REPLACEMENT KNOB.  TO-DATE, I HAVE REPLACED 5 KNOBS. 

A TECHNICIAN FROM DIAMOND FACTORY SERVICE WAS SENT OUT BY THE JENNAIR SAFETY TEAM AND I WAS INFORMED THAT JENNAIR HAD BEEN NOTIFIED OF THIS SAFETY ISSUE AND THAT PRODUCT MANAGERS HAVE BEEN ONSITE DURING SERVICE CALLS AND PERSONALLY WITNESSED SAID HAZARDS. USING PLASTIC PARTS AGAINST METAL STEMS IS INHERENTLY DEFECTIVE.  AN OVEN NOT CLOSING ALSO CONSTITUTES A HAZARD.  

THIS RANGE HAS DEFECTS THAT POSE SERIOUS SAFETY HAZARDS AND SHOULD BE RECALLED. THE KNOBS AND OVEN CLOSURE MECHANISM ARE BOTH DEFECTIVE AND SHOULD BE REPLACED.  ALTERNATIVELY, IF I CANNOT SAFELY USE THIS APPLIANCE WITHOUT RISK OF INJURY OR DEATH, I WOULD LIKE A REFUND.  I WOULD BE OPEN TO A REPLACEMENT PROVIDED THE REPLACEMENT DOES NOT CONTAIN THE PLASTIC INTERIOR PARTS.

incident_description: I WAS USING THE NINJA PROFESSIONAL PLUS KITCHEN SYSTEM TO MAKE SMOOTHIES.  I SMELLED AN UNUSUAL SMELL THAT SMELLED LIKE SOMETHING BURNING.  I DIDN'T SEE ANY SMOKE OR ANY INDICATION OF A PROBLEM WITH THE UNIT AND THOUGHT THE SMELL MIGHT BE COMING FROM OUTSIDE MY HOUSE.   I SERVED THE SMOOTHIES TO MY 2 SONS.  ONE DRANK THE SMOOTHIE; THE OTHER SAID IT DID NOT TASTE GOOD.  WHEN I SMELLED HIS SMOOTHIE, IT SMELLED LIKE THE SAME BURNING SMELL I SMELLED WHILE MAKING THEM.  I PUT WATER AND A FEW ICE CUBES IN THE NINJA SMOOTHIE CONTAINER, PUT IT IN THE BASE, AND TURNED IT ON.  I WAS SHOCKED TO SEE THE WATER TURN BLACKISH WITH SEDIMENTS OF A BLACK SUBSTANCE.   I AM VERY CONCERNED BECAUSE ONE OF MY SONS DRANK THE SMOOTHIE THAT HAD THIS SUBSTANCE.  I KEPT THE SMOOTHIE CONTAINER THAT HAS THE WATER AND BLACK SUBSTANCE, HOPING IT WOULD BE ANALYZED TO DETERMINE WHAT IT IS.   THE FIRST WEEK OF NOVEMBER, WHEN THIS OCCURRED,  I IMMEDIATELY CONTACTED THE SHARK/NINJA COMPANY.  THE CUSTOMER REPRESENTATIVE I SPOKE WITH TOLD ME THEY WERE GOING TO EXPEDITE A RETURN CALL TO ADDRESS MY CONCERNS AND THAT I SHOULD HEAR BACK WITHIN TWO DAYS.  I DID NOT HEAR BACK THAT WEEK.  THE FOLLOWING WEEK, I CONTACTED THE COMPANY AGAIN.  AGAIN, I WAS TOLD THEY WOULD EXPEDIATE A RESPONSE AND THAT I SHOULD HEAR BACK WITHIN TWO DAYS.  IT HAS NOW BEEN FOUR WEEKS, AND I HAVE NOT HEARD BACK FROM ANYONE AT SHARK/NINJA.  MY CONCERN IS THAT SOMETHING FROM THE MACHINE ENTERED THE CONTAINER AND CONTAMINATED THE CONTENTS OF THE SMOOTHIES I PREPARED.  I AM VERY CONCERNED THAT THIS SUBSTANCE MAY HAVE ENTERED OTHER FOOD THAT I HAVE PREPARED IN THE UNIT.  I AM ALSO VERY CONCERNED THAT THIS COULD HAPPEN TO SOMEONE ELSE.  I OFFERED TO SEND MY UNIT AND THE CONTAINER THAT HAS THE WATER AND BLACK SUBSTANCE TO SHARK/NINJA, BUT THEY HAVE BEEN UNRESPONSIVE.  DURING THE SECOND CALL, THEY DID OFFER TO SEND ME ANOTHER UNIT, BUT I WOULD NEVER TAKE A CHANCE USING THIS APPLIANCE AGAIN.  I HOPE THAT SOMEONE CAN HELP DETERMINE WHAT THIS BLACK SUBSTANCE IS AND WHETHER IT COULD HARM MY SON'S HEALTH.

WE BOUGHT A CONDO WHICH INCLUDED A BOSCH SIDE BY SIDE, BUILT IN REFRIGERATOR AND ICE MAKER.  THE PRIOR OWNER BOUGHT THE UNIT NEW AND NEVER OCCUPIED IT, SO THE REFRIGERATOR WAS TURNED ON, BUT NEVER USED IN DAY-TO-DAY SERVICE.  THE PROBLEM I AM REPORTING IS THAT THE CERAMIC WATER LINE TO THE ICE MAKER HAS DISINTEGRATED, CAUSING MINUTE CERAMIC DEBRIS PARTICLES TO FLOW INTO THE WATER THAT IS BECOMING ICE.  THE ICE IS UNUSABLE AND UNSAFE.  THE LINE IS SURROUNDED BY FOAM INSULATION FROM THE MANUFACTURER, SO IT IS NOT ACCESSIBLE AND CANNOT BE REPLACED.  THE DISINTEGRATION OF THE LINE IS A DEFECT THAT WAS NOT CAUSED BY MISUSE.  THERE IS NO ACCESS TO THE LINE AND NO SITUATION OF OPERATING USE OF THE LINE THAT COULD CAUSE LINE TO FRACTURE AND DISINTEGRATE THE WAY IT DID.  THE PROBLEM WAS DISCOVERED BY AN INDEPENDENT REPAIR TECHNICIAN.  THE PROBLEM WAS MASKED BY OTHER DEFECTS IN THE FREEZER, WHICH INCLUDED A DISCONNECTED (SEVERED) WIRE THAT SHOULD HAVE POWERED A FAN IN THE FREEZER.  BECAUSE THE FAN DID NOT WORK, THE ICE MAKER NEVER FUNCTIONED BECAUSE THERE IS A TEMPERATURE CONTROLLER THAT PREVENTS OPERATION OF THE ICE MAKER WHEN THE AMBIENT TEMPERATURE IN THE FREEZER EXCEEDS A PRESET TEMPERATURE.  A BSH APPROVED SERVICER ATTEMPTED TO REPAIR THE FAN PROBLEM AND AFTER SEVERAL UNSUCCESSFUL REPAIR ATTEMPTS, DECLARED THE UNIT TO BE NOT SERVICEABLE.  I SOUGHT A REPLACEMENT OF THE REFRIGERATOR.  BOSCH ADVISED ME THAT THE UNIT WAS OUT OF WARRANTY, BUT THEY WOULD OFFER ME $1,484.85 AGAINST THE PURCHASE OF A NEW $9,899 REPLACEMENT UNIT.  SINCE THE REPLACEMENT UNIT COST AND INSTALLATION FAR EXCEEDS BSH OFFER, I SOUGHT AN INDEPENDENT REPAIR.  THAT REPAIR PERSON WAS ABLE TO FIX THE WIRING ISSUE AND RESTORE NORMAL FAN FUNCTION, BUT THEN DISCOVERED THAT THE CERAMIC WATER LINE WAS DISINTEGRATING AND THAT IT COULD NOT BE REPLACED AND REPRESENTED A SAFETY HAZARD AS PIECES BROKE OFF AND FLOWED INTO THE ICE.  WE HAVE NOT USED THE ICE AND SO HAVE NOT BEEN INJURED, BUT ANYONE WITH THIS REFRIGERATOR AND THIS PROBLEM WOULD NOT KNOW THAT FOREIGN BODIES ARE FLOWING INTO THE ICE AND SO THIS IS A DANGER TO CONSUMERS.  I HAVE OTHER BOSCH PRODUCTS, AND HAVE A BOSCH REFRIGERATOR IN ANOTHER DWELLING, AND TYPICALLY BOSCH MAKES A QUALITY PRODUCT.  I AM CONFOUNDED BY HOW THIS ISSUE HAPPENED AND WHY THIS REFRIGERATOR PRESENTED WITH PROBLEMS THAT NEITHER REPAIR PERSON HAD SEEN IN THEIR CAREERS.

I HAD NOT USED MY MASSAGE GUN IN OVER A YEAR, AND THE BATTERY WAS COMPLETELY DISCHARGED. I PLUGGED IT IN TO CHARGE WITH THE ORIGINAL CHARGING CORD. ABOUT 20 MINUTES LATER, WHILE SITTING A FEW FEET AWAY, I HEARD AN EXTREMELY LOUD BANG AS THE BATTERY EXPLODED. SMOKE BEGAN POURING OUT OF THE DEVICE. I QUICKLY UNPLUGGED IT FROM THE ELECTRICAL WALL OUTLET AND OPENED A WINDOW.
A FEW MINUTES LATER, WHILE ASSESSING THE SITUATION, THERE WAS A SECONDARY EXPLOSION. THICK WHITE AND GRAY SMOKE FILLED THE ROOM, AND BLACK ASHES EMERGED FROM THE BATTERY COMPARTMENT OF THE MASSAGE GUN. I RETRIEVED A FIRE EXTINGUISHER AND MONITORED THE SITUATION. FORTUNATELY, THERE WERE NO FLAMES, AND I WAS ABLE TO REMOVE THE MASSAGE GUN FROM MY HOUSE USING GLOVES AND PLACING IT IN A BOX. IN HINDSIGHT, I SHOULD HAVE CALLED THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, BUT EVERYTHING HAPPENED SO QUICKLY.
IT TOOK 12 HOURS WITH ALL WINDOWS OPEN AND FANS ON TO CLEAR THE CHEMICAL SMOKE. THE INCIDENT CONTAMINATED NEARBY LINENS AND LEFT SCORCH MARKS ON THE TABLE, ALONG WITH BLACK SOOT SURROUNDING THE AREA.
FORTUNATELY, I WAS SITTING FAR ENOUGH AWAY WHEN IT OCCURRED THAT I WAS UNINJURED, AND IT WAS ON A FIRE-RESISTANT SURFACE. IF I HAD BEEN HOLDING IT, I COULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUSLY INJURED, AND IF IT HAD BEEN ON A DIFFERENT SURFACE, IT MIGHT HAVE RESULTED IN A FIRE. IM ALSO GRATEFUL THAT I WAS HOME WHEN IT HAPPENED; IF IT HAD OCCURRED WHILE I WAS AWAY, MY PETS COULD HAVE BEEN AT RISK OF CHEMICAL SMOKE INHALATION AND POISONING, IN ADDITION TO THE RISK OF A HOUSE FIRE.
IM ALSO RELIEVED THAT I DIDNT TRY TO REMOVE IT FROM THE HOUSE AFTER THE FIRST EXPLOSION, AS I COULD HAVE BEEN INJURED DURING THE SECONDARY EXPLOSION. THE INCIDENT WAS VERY FRIGHTENING, AND IM FORTUNATE THAT CIRCUMSTANCES PREVENTED INJURY OR SERIOUS DAMAGE.

ON DECEMBER 8, 2019 I PURCHASED A SAMSUNG REFRIGERATOR, MODEL NUMBER RF263BEAESGAA, FOR $1,547.00 AT HOME DEPOT. AROUND MAY OF 2024, MY FAMILY AND I NOTICED THAT THE REFRIGERATORS  TEMPERATURE FELT CONSISTENTLY WARMER THAN USUAL. ON MAY 28, 2024, WHILE SEARCHING ONLINE FOR INFORMATION ABOUT THESE ONGOING ISSUES WITH SUBJECT REFRIGERATOR, I LEARNED OF THE CLASS ACTION AGAINST SAMSUNG (ALONG WITH NUMEROUS OTHER PRODUCT DEFECT RELATED LAWSUITS AGAINST SAMSUNG) REGARDING THE VERY SAME PROBLEMS WE WERE EXPERIENCING WITH OUR OWN APPLIANCE.
WHILE READING ABOUT THE LITIGATION, I DISCOVERED THAT SAMSUNG WAS OFFERING A SERVICE CALL AND REPLACEMENT PART, FREE OF CHARGE, TO REMEDY THIS KNOWN DEFECT. I IMMEDIATELY CALLED SAMSUNG, PROVIDED MY APPLIANCES INFORMATION, AND WAS GIVEN A TICKET NUMBER AS CONFIRMATION OF MY UPCOMING SERVICE APPOINTMENT FOR THE REPAIR AND INSTALLATION OF THE REPLACEMENT PART.  

SOON AFTER THIS CALL, I RECEIVED A TEXT MESSAGE FROM A SAMSUNG REPRESENTATIVE NAMED [REDACTED] WHO REQUESTED THAT I SEND HER PHOTOS OF THE REFRIGERATORS  ICE MAKER UNIT.  I TRIED TO UPLOAD THE PHOTOS ON THE PORTAL WEBSITE PROVIDED BY SAMSUNG IN ITS SECOND CONFIRMATION EMAIL, BUT I WAS UNABLE TO COMPLETE THE UPLOAD DUE TO ERRORS ON THE SITE. AFTER BEING CONTACTED BY SAMSUNG REPRESENTATIVES [REDACTED] AND [REDACTED], I WAS FINALLY ABLE TO TEXT PHOTOS OF THE FRIDGE AND THE RECEIPT ON JUNE 3, 2024 

THROUGHOUT THE FOLLOWING WEEKS, I FREQUENTLY VISITED THE SAMSUNG CUSTOMER SERVICE PORTAL TO CHECK THE STATUS OF MY SERVICE REQUEST. EACH TIME I VISITED THIS SITE (EVEN ON THE DAY OF THE JULY 26, 2024 INCIDENT) I WAS MET WITH THE SAME MESSAGE , WHICH STATED: DEAR CUSTOMER, YOUR REQUEST HAS BEEN RECEIVED AND WE ARE IN THE PROCESS OF REVIEWING THE SUBMITTED DOCUMENTS. YOU WILL ONLY BE ABLE TO ACCESS THE PORTAL, TO SEND ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTATION, ONCE THE DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN REVIEWED. HERE AT SAMSUNG, WE PRIDE OURSELVES IN PROVIDING CUSTOMER SERVICE NOTHING SHORT OF EXCELLENCE. PLEASE FEEL FREE TO REACH OUT TO US FOR STATUS UPDATES OR ANY ADDITIONAL INQUIRIES.

	I CONTINUED TO CHECK THE PORTAL THROUGHOUT THE MONTHS OF JUNE AND JULY OF 2024. IN MID-JULY, MY 5-YEAR-OLD SON AND I BEGAN EXPERIENCING BOUTS OF VOMITING AND DIARRHEA WHENEVER WE WOULD DRINK SOMETHING OUT OF THE FRIDGE. IT GOT TO THE POINT THAT EVERY TIME  MY SON WOULD HAVE A GLASS OF MILK, HE WOULD VOMIT VIOLENTLY. ON JULY 26, 2024, I DECIDED TO DEEP CLEAN THE SUBJECT REFRIGERATOR AND BEGAN REMOVING THE REFRIGERATORS CONTENTS. IT WAS THEN THAT I DISCOVERED THAT THE BACK PANELS WERE ICED UP. ADDITIONALLY, WATER WAS DRIPPING DOWN THE BACK OF THE MAIN COMPARTMENT INTO THE VEGETABLE COMPARTMENTS AND POOLING UNDER THE TRAYS. AS I PULLED OPEN THE TRAYS, WATER GUSHED OUT ONTO MY KITCHEN FLOOR. OBVIOUSLY ALARMED, I CALLED THE PHONE NUMBER LISTED ON MY SAMSUNG WORK ORDER. I EXPLAINED THE CURRENT SITUATION TO THE REPRESENTATIVE AND ASKED HIM ABOUT THE STATUS OF MY PENDING SERVICE REQUEST. TO MY UTTER SURPRISE, THE REPRESENTATIVE INFORMED ME THAT MY SERVICE REQUEST WAS CLOSED OUT. I ASKED HOW IT COULD POSSIBLY BE CLOSED OUT SINCE NOBODY HAD YET CONTACTED ME TO SCHEDULE THE SERVICE. ACCORDING TO THE WEBSITE, MY DOCUMENTS WERE STILL BEING REVIEWED. THE REPRESENTATIVE ANSWERED THAT SAMSUNG CLOSED OUT THE REQUEST SINCE THEY COULD NOT FIND A TECHNICIAN AVAILABLE THAT WOULD COMPLETE MY SERVICE. 
	 I HAVE NEVER HEARD OF A COMPANY CANCELLING OUT ITS OWN WORK ORDER TO REMEDY A DEFECTIVE PRODUCT THAT POSED A HEALTH AND SAFETY HAZARD. SAMSUNG KNEW OF THIS PRODUCTS DEFECT, ACCEPTED MY CLAIM, AND WAS IN THE PROCESS OF SCHEDULING A SERVICE CALL FOR MY UNIT. ACCORDING TO THEIR OWN PORTAL, MY CLAIM WAS STILL ACTIVE. YET SAMSUNG DECIDED TO CLOSE OUT MY REQUEST AND REFUSE TO FOLLOW THROUGH ON THE REPAIR WITHOUT EVEN CONTACTING ME ABOUT THEIR INABILITY TO COMPLETE THE PROCESS. DUE TO SAMSUNGS NEGLIGENCE IN MISHANDLING MY REPAIR REQUEST, THE DEFECTIVE COMPONENT FAILED AND CAUSED THIS MAJOR ISSUE. I EXPRESSED MY SHOCK TO THE SAMSUNG REPRESENTATIVE AND EXPLAINED THAT IT WAS CURRENTLY 105 DEGREES IN MY AREA; THUS, I NEEDED MY REFRIGERATOR REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. HE ASSURED ME THAT HE WOULD GIVE ME A TICKET NUMBER TO HAVE SOMEONE RESPOND TO ME WITHIN 48 HOURS, WHO WOULD THEN ARRANGE A DATE TO INSPECT THE SUBJECT REFRIGERATOR. I REMINDED HIM THAT THE LAST TIME I FOLLOWED THIS PROCEDURE, MY REQUEST WAS CLOSED OUT WITHOUT ANY NOTICE.  ADDITIONALLY, SINCE THE SUBJECT REFRIGERATOR WAS FLOODING AND INOPERABLE, I NEEDED TO HAVE THE SERVICE, REPAIR, AND/OR REPLACEMENT PROVIDED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. THE SAMSUNG REPRESENTATIVE GAVE ME THE NUMBER OF THE LOCAL APPLIANCE REPAIR TECHNICIAN TO SEE IF I COULD GET THEM TO COME TO MY HOME EARLIER DUE TO THIS EMERGENCY SITUATION.

THIS GLASS INSERT IS VERY HEAVY - ESTIMATED AT MORE THAN 30 LBS. IT IS INSERTED INTO THE STORM DOOR FRAME FROM THE INSIDE OF THE DOOR AFTER REMOVING THE SCREEN INSERT. IN ORDER SWAP THE SCREEN FOR THE GLASS INSERT, A SWITCH NEEDS TO BE ACTIVATED ON THE DOOR SO THAT THE DOOR HANDLE LEVER CAN BE MOVED INTO THE FULL VERTICAL POSITION. THIS LEVER POSITION DISENGAGES THE MECHANISM THAT HOLDS THE INSERT (GLASS INSERT, OR SCREEN INSERT) IN PLACE. AFTER INSERTING THE HEAVY GLASS INSERT AND RETURNING THE DOOR HANDLE TO THE HORIZONTAL POSITION, THE SWITCH IS SUPPOSED TO RE-ENGAGE TO PREVENT THE LEVER FROM MOVING INTO THE RELEASE POSITION, AND THE MECHANISM IS SUPPOSED TO RETAIN THE HEAVY GLASS INSERT. HOWEVER, DUE TO AN UNKNOWN MECHANICAL DEFECT/FAILURE, THE DOOR HANDLE LEVER CAN BE MOVED TO THE FULL UPRIGHT AND VERTICAL POSITION WITHOUT ACTUATING THE SWITCH. THIS DISENGAGES THE MECHANISM THAT RETAINS THE INSERT IN THE FRAME OF THE STORM DOOR, ALLOWING THE GLASS INSERT TO FREE-FALL INTO THE HOUSE, POTENTIALLY FALLING ON PEOPLE OR PETS INSIDE THE ENTRYWAY. I PURCHASED TWO 16 OUNCE PHILADELPHIA EAGLES GLASSES 1/23/24 FROM FANATICS.COM.  THE PRODUCT DESCRIPTION STATES, DISHWASHER SAFE.  THAT IS ONE OF THE MAIN REASONS I BOUGHT THE GLASSES.  BUT AFTER I PUT THE FIRST GLASS IN THE DISHWASHER, THE PHILADELPHIA SCRIPT, EAGLES SCRIPT, EAGLE, SILVER LINE, AND GREEN LINE DECALS ARE DISMEMBERED WITH SOME COMPLETELY MISSING.  I WILL ATTACH PHOTOS, BUT HAVE TO RETURN THE GLASSES.  IN SMALL TYPE ON THE BOX IS THIS STATEMENT, "GLASSWARE IS TOP SHELF DISHWASHER SAFE."  I PLACED THE GLASS IN THE TOP SHELF OF MY DISHWASHER.  THIS DAMAGE AND THE RELEASE OF POTENTIALLY HARMFUL SUBSTANCES SHOULD NOT HAVE HAPPENED TO A DISHWASHER SAFE ITEM.  THAT IS FALSE ADVERTISING TO MISLEADINGLY PROMOTE AN ITEM TO BE DISHWASHER SAFE, WHEN IN FACT IT IS NOT DISHWASHER SAFE, AND POTENTIALLY HARMFUL SUBSTANCES WERE DETACHED FROM THE GLASS.  I DID NOT WANT TO PUT THE OTHER GLASS IN THE DISHWASHER FOR FEAR THAT HARMFUL MATERIALS WOULD COME OFF THE GLASS.  THIS IS A CONSUMER SAFETY ISSUE.  IF IT HAPPENED TO ME, IT COULD HAPPEN TO ANYONE.  FANATICS SELLS AND MANUFACTURER LOGO BRANDS MAKES A WIDE RANGE OF 16 OUNCE GLASSES FEATURING DECALS OF MANY SPORTS TEAMS.  THAT MEANS THERE IS A POTENTIAL THAT THOSE PRODUCTS ARE NOT DISHWASHER SAFE.  I TRIED TO LOCATE THE DECALS MISSING FROM THE GLASS, BUT COULD NOT FIND THEM IN THE DISHWASHER.  THESE ARE SMALL DECALS, WHICH IF DETACHED FROM THE GLASS CAN VERY POSSIBLY BE INGESTED BY A CONSUMER.  THIS CAN BE HARMFUL.  BOTH ON FANATICS WEBSITE AND LOGO BRANDS WEBSITE, THESE GLASSES ARE MARKETED AS DISHWASHER SAFE.  IT COULD BE THAT THE GLASSES I RECEIVED WERE DEFECTIVE (WHICH IS UNSAFE).  OR IT COULD BE THAT THESE GLASSES ARE NOT DISHWASHER SAFE.  I BELIEVE THIS WARRANTS FURTHER INVESTIGATION.  THROUGH CHATS, EMAILS, AND FINALLY AFTER I DEMANDED A NUMBER TO CALL A FANATICS CUSTOMER SERVICE SUPERVISOR, I WAS ABLE TO GET EXPLANATIONS.  AN EMAIL FROM A FANATICS CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE STATED, "UNFORTUNATELY, THE PHILADELPHIA EAGLES 16OZ. PINT GLASS TWO PACK IS NOT DISHWASHER SAFE LIKE THE SITE STATES.  WE ARE WORKING TO GET THE INFORMATION UPDATED/REMOVED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE."  THE SUPERVISOR TOLD ME HE WILL MONITOR TO MAKE SURE THE DISHWASHER SAFE STATEMENT IS REMOVED FROM THE ONLINE PRODUCT DESCRIPTION.  SO FANATICS ADMITTED IN WRITING THAT THE PRODUCT IT PROMOTES AS DISHWASHER SAFE IS NOT DISHWASHER SAFE.  MEANWHILE, THE ONLY RESPONSE I RECEIVED FROM LOGO BRANDS SHOWED LITTLE CONCERN.  AS I DID WITH FANATICS, I ASKED FOR CONFIRMATION FROM LOGO BRANDS THAT THESE GLASSES ARE DISHWASHER SAFE.  I CAN PROVIDE THE ENTIRE EMAIL TEXT, BUT FOR NOW, HERE IS THE RESPONSE FROM A LOGO BRANDS CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE, "I WOULD SAY THAT MOST OF OUR GLASSES ARE DISHWASHER SAFE, BUT LIKE ANY PRODUCT THERE CAN BE A PROBLEM DURING MANUFACTURING AND ERRORS CAN OCCUR."  LOGO BRANDS DOES NOT SEEM WILLING TO EVEN CONSIDER THE POSSIBILITY THAT ONE OR ANY OR ALL OF THEIR PRODUCTS ARE NOT DISHWASHER SAFE.  SO I AM FILING THIS REPORT.  I HOPE THE CPSC PURSUES THIS INVESTIGATION TO DETERMINE IF WHAT HAPPENED TO ME WAS BECAUSE OF A DEFECTIVE ITEM (A SAFETY ISSUE) OR A PRODUCT CLAIMED TO BE DISHWASHER SAFE THAT IS IN FACT NOT DISHWASHER SAFE (ALSO A SAFETY ISSUE).  IF THESE GLASSES ARE NOT SAFE TO BE WASHED IN THE DISHWASHER, THEN THEY SHOULD NOT BE MARKETED AS DISHWASHER SAFE.

THE BATTERIES WERE ALL PURCHASED NEW WITH NEW EQUIPMENT IN MAY OF 2023, AND USED WITHIN MANUFACTURER GUIDELINES.  THE BATTERIES WERE KEPT ON THE CHARGER ONLY WHEN CHARGING, AND REMOVED ONCE THEY WERE FULLY CHARGED. WE ALWAYS STORED THEM OFF THE CHARGER IN A KITCHEN CABINET THAT IS DRY AND MAINTAINED AT 68-74 DEGREES YEAR ROUND. WE WERE LUCKY (A) TO HAVE BEEN HOME TO NOTICE THE SMOKE AND REMOVE THE BURNING BATTERY BEFORE IT CAUSED A HOUSE FIRE, AND (B) TO HAVE ENOUGH TIME TO RESEARCH HOW TO EXTINGUISH THE BATTERY AND NOT USE A STANDARD FIRE EXTINGUISHER OR WATER ON IT, WHICH ACTUALLY MAKES BATTERY FIRES WORSE. incident_description: OUR OVEN TURNED ITSELF ON ON THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT AGAIN... THE THIRD TIME THIS WEEK, AND JUST THE MOST RECENT OF DOZENS OF PREVIOUS TIMES! WE WOKE UP FROM THE SMELL OF BURNING, AND THE ENTIRE HOUSE WAS FILLED WITH AN ACRID SMOKE THAT BURNED THE EYES. A BURNER HAS SPONTANEOUSLY TURNED ITSELF ON AND HEATED THE STOVE, WHERE A SMALL PLASTIC BAG CONTAINING BREAD HAD BEEN SET THE NIGHT BEFORE, MELTING THE PLASTIC AND BURNING THE BREAD BLACK. NO ONE HAD BEEN IN THE KITCHEN OR WAS USING THE OVEN. THIS DEFECTIVE APPLIANCE NEARLY BURNED OUR HOUSE DOWN! WE ALREADY DISLIKED THIS DOUBLE-OVEN/STOVE COMBO PRODUCT, AND HAVE HAD SEVERAL ISSUES INCLUDING THE GLASS TOP SURFACE CRACK, AS WELL AS THE WILDLY OVERSENSITIVE CONTROL PANEL BUTTONS THAT WILL TURN THE OVEN AND/OR STOVE ON OR OFF WHEN ONE IS STANDING OVER THE FRONT OF THE RANGE AND JUST SLIGHTLY LEANS FORWARD. AFTER A HANDFUL OF SIMILAR INCIDENTS WE HAVE LEARNED TO OBSESSIVELY CHECK WHETHER THE APPLIANCE IS OFF AND THE LOCK BUTTON ENGAGED, FOR FEAR OF FIRE. UNFORTUNATELY, THE LOCK BUTTON CANNOT BE USED TO PREVENT ADDITIONAL COOKING FUNCTIONS FROM ENGAGING IF ONE OF THE DUAL OVENS OR ONE OF FIVE BURNERS IS ON, AND WILL SHUT OFF ALL FUNCTIONS. ANOTHER ANNOYANCE IS THAT WE CANNOT EVEN USE THE TIMER FUNCTION BY ITSELF (WITHOUT THE OVEN OR STOVE HEATING) WHILE APPLIANCE IS LOCKED, SO EVEN IF WE DO NOT USE THE RANGE TO COOK ONE EVENING, WE STILL HAVE TO COMPULSIVELY CHECK THAT THE CONTROL PANEL IS LOCKED IF WEVE USED THE TIMER AT ALL. IN ADDITION TO THIS PHANTOM COOKING, THE VENTILATION AT THE TOP REAR OF THE PRODUCT RELEASES SUCH STEAMING AIR FROM THE OVEN THAT ANYTHING OR ANYONE NEAR THE SIDE OR BACK COUNTERTOPS CAN BE DAMAGED (MELTED, BURNED, OR CAUGHT FIRE) OR INJURED (BARSTOOL SEATING AT SPLIT LEVEL HEIGHT). WE CAN NO LONGER KEEP ANYTHING REMOTELY NEAR OUR STOVE, NOR HAVE HIGHTOP BARSTOOL SEATING FOR OURSELVES OR GUESTS TO SIT. FINALLY, THE DOOR HANDLE OF THE LOWER OVEN, WHEN OPENED, HITS THE FLOOR AND THE HEIGHT A PERSON MUST STOOP TO IN ORDER TO LIFT OUT THE HOT CONTENTS IS COMPLETELY ABSURD EVEN FOR A SHORT PERSON; THIS CANNOT POSSIBLY BE SAFE OR INTENDED! THERE IS AN OBVIOUS RISK OF THE GLASS DOOR SHATTERING FROM THE IMPACT OF THE HANDLE HITTING THE FLOOR, AS WELL AS A USER BEING SCALDED/BURNED WHILE REMOVING ITEMS FROM THE LOWER OVEN. EVERYTHING ABOUT THIS PRODUCT IS POORLY DESIGNED.

WITH THE LIGHT SWITCH IN THE "OFF" POSITION, I RECEIVED A 110V SHOCK WHILE REPLACING A LIGHT BULB IN A ZEPHYR SAVONA ZSA-M90S RANGE HOOD.  THE SHOCK CAUSED MINOR INJURY TO MY HAND.  THE CIRCUIT WAS NOT (NOR WAS IT REQUIRED TO BE) A GFCI NOR AFCI, SO THE CIRCUIT REMAINED ONLINE EVEN AFTER I HAD RECEIVED THE SHOCK.

...

I AM THE OWNER OF THE HOME AND THE APPLIANCE.

...

DURING THE INSTALLATION, I WAS FOLLOWING ALL LABELED INSTRUCTIONS ON THE UNIT, AS WELL AS ALL WARNINGS IN THE MANUAL.  I WAS ALSO PRACTICING BASIC SAFETY TECHNIQUES ASSOCIATED WITH CHANGING A TYPICAL HOUSEHOLD (E26, EDISON-BASE) LIGHT BULB.

...

UPON FURTHER INVESTIGATION, I DISCOVERED THAT THE CIRCUIT CONTROLLING THE LIGHT IS SWITCHED-NEUTRAL.  THE SAME CIRCUIT ALSO CONTROLS THE MOTOR, SO THE MOTOR IS ALSO SWITCHED-NEUTRAL.  THIS APPLIANCE IS THUS UNSAFE BY DESIGN; ANY ATTEMPT BY AN END-USER TO REPLACE THE LIGHT BULB WOULD REQUIRE DE-ENERGIZING THE ENTIRETY OF THE CIRCUIT AT THE BREAKER PANEL IN ORDER TO AVOID BEING SHOCKED.  FURTHER, ANY SHORT TO GROUND ON THE NEUTRAL SIDE WOULD RESULT IN, AT MINIMUM, THE ENERGIZING OF ONE OR MORE ELEMENTS OF THE APPLIANCE WITHOUT ANY ABILITY TO TURN THEM OFF, IF NOT ALSO ELECTRICAL ARC/FIRE HAZARDS.

...

A RETROFIT KIT, CONSISTING OF ZEPHYR PART NUMBERS 11000041 AND 56210050, IS AVAILABLE.  THIS RETROFIT KIT MAINTAINS THE SWITCHED-NEUTRAL CONFIGURATION.  FIGURE 1 ON PAGE 2 OF THE  THE DOCUMENT "ZSA-M90S SWITCH RETROFIT", LABELED "MAY08.0301", SHOWS A WIRING DIAGRAM FOR THE KIT.  THIS DIAGRAM CLEARLY SHOWS THAT THE INTENDED WIRING IS THAT THE WHITE (NEUTRAL) WIRE FROM THE AC SUPPLY GOES TO THE SWITCH, WHILE THE BLACK (HOT/LINE) WIRE GOES DIRECTLY TO THE LIGHTS.

...

FURTHER, THE DESIGN OF THE LAMPHOLDER ITSELF IS PROBLEMATIC.  A [REDACTED]  (PHENOLIC RESIN) LAMPHOLDER BASE IS ATTACHED TO A "TRAPEZE".  THIS TRAPEZE IS BENT DOWNWARDS TO ENABLE THREADING OF THE BULB, THEN BENT BACK UP SO THAT THE BULB FITS SNUGLY AGAINST THE BOTTOM PLATE OF THE RANGE HOOD.  PERFORMING THIS OPERATION REQUIRES THE USER TO PLACE THEIR HANDS INSIDE THE CAVITY OF THE RANGE HOOD, INCREASING THE LIKELIHOOD OF EXPOSURE TO THE LIVE 110V LEG OF THE CIRCUIT THAT IS ALWAYS PRESENT.  IT ALSO MEANS THAT A USER WHO WISHES TO HAVE THE LIGHTS SIT FLUSH AS DESIGNED MUST CAREFULLY BALANCE BETWEEN SCREWING IN THE BULB FURTHER AND RETRACTING THE TRAPEZE.  THESE ACTIONS INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF THE E26 THREADS EMBEDDED INTO THE PHENOLIC RESIN BREAKING DOWN/APART, AS THEY DID IN MY CASE; THIS WAS A CONTRIBUTING CAUSE OF THE SHOCK THAT I RECEIVED, THOUGH IN A DIFFERENT CONFIGURATION, THE BROKEN THREADS COULD EASILY HAVE PROVIDED A SHORT-CIRCUIT PATH THAT BYPASSED THE LAMP, POSING A FIRE HAZARD.

...

WHILE REWIRING THE MOTOR TO NO LONGER BE SWITCHED-NEUTRAL IS BEYOND MY SKILLS, I WAS ULTIMATELY ABLE TO EFFECT A SIMPLE RETROFIT TO REMEDY THE ISSUE WITH THE LIGHTS.  WITH ONE OF THE TRACES ON THE PCB REMOVED, I RAN A SEPARATE WIRE FOR "HOT" TO THE SWITCH FOR THE LIGHTS, AND THEN REVERSED THEIR POSITIONING ON THE DOWNSTREAM LAMPHOLDERS.  IT'S PROBABLY NOT REALISTIC TO EXPECT AN END-USER TO BE COMFORTABLE BREAKING TRACES ON A PCB, BUT MY RETROFIT DEMONSTRATES THAT ZEPHYR COULD AT LEAST PARTIALLY RESOLVE THIS ISSUE FOR NO MORE THAN THE COST OF A REPLACEMENT PCB AND A WIRE OR TWO.

I HAVE NOTES ABOUT THE CALL AND THE NAMES OF THE SKYTECH EMPLOYEES. AT THAT POINT, THE TONE OF THE CALL CHANGED AND THE SUPERVISOR WAS INSISTENT THAT I WAS DOING SOMETHING WRONG AND WOULD NOT EVEN RESPOND WHEN I TOLD HER THAT THESE SPONTANEOUS COMBUSTION EVENTS OCCURRED WHEN NO ONE WAS EVEN NEAR THE CONTROLLERS.

AT THAT POINT, I WENT BACK TO CJ BENNETT AND ATTEMPTED TO RETURN THE CONTROLLERS. AFTER SEVERAL MONTHS OF NEGOTIATION, THEY COULD PROVIDE AN ACCEPTABLE SOLUTION. THESE PRODUCTS ARE UNSAFE AND SHOULD BE INVESTIGATED BEFORE SOMEONE'S HOUSE BURNS DOWN.

LG RANGE CHILD LOCK RESET TO UNLOCKED STATE DURING BRIEF POWER OUTAGE, CAUSING A FIRE. THE CHILD LOCK HAD BEEN SET TO PREVENT THE BURNERS FROM BEING TURNED ON BY THE DOG OR OTHUR KITCHEN ACTIVITY. THE FRONT MOUNTED  KNOBS ARE INCREDIBLY SENSITIVE AND A LIGHT PUSH WILL ALLOW THEM TO TURN. POWER WENT OUT BRIEFLY CAUSING THE CHILD LOCK TO SWITCH OFF. DOG BUMPED INTO THE KNOB SHORTLY AFTER THE POWER OUTAGE WHILE NO ONE ELSE WAS DOWNSTAIRS WHICH TURNED A BURNER ON. A PLASTIC CONTAINER OF SUGAR NEAR THE BURNER MELTED ONTO THE BURNER AND CAUGHT FIRE, CAUSING NEARBY ITEMS TO ALSO FLAME UP. FIRE WAS PUT OUT BEFORE IT SPREAD FURTHER INTO THE KITCHEN. SINCE THEN THE POWER OUTAGE RESET ISSUE HAS BEEN REPLICATED MULTIPLE TIMES. IF THE CHILD LOCK IS SET AND THE POWER GOES OUT FOR EVEN A SECOND, THE CHILD LOCK TURNS OFF. IF A BURNER KNOB IS TURNED INTO AN ON POSITION WHILE THE POWER OUTAGE RESETS THE CHILD LOCK, THE BURNER WILL AUTOMATICALLY COME ON WHEN THE CHILD LOCK RESETS AFTER THE OUTAGE. THE KNOBS ARE SO SENSITIVE THAT LIGHTLY LEANING OVER THE STOVE  OR BUMPING THEM WITH A CABINET DOOR WILL PUSH THEM IN AND TURN THEM. THE PUSH TO TURN FUNCTION OFFERS VERY MINIMAL RESISTANCE MAKING IT EASY FOR THEM TO BE TURNED BY ACCIDENT. BOTH OF THESE ISSUES CAUSE A FIRE RISK AND A SAFETY HAZARD.

incident_description:
MY 10-MONTH OLD SON CHOKED ON AND NEARLY SWALLOWED A METAL BOLT THAT CAME WITH AN INFANTS TOY PLAY GYM, THAT HAD COME LOOSE ON ITS OWN DUE TO THE UNRELIABLE (AND IN MY CARPENTER'S OPINION, INCOMPATIBLE) HARDWARE THAT WAS INCLUDED IN THE ASSEMBLY. HE WAS SUDDENLY CHOKING NEAR THE PLAY GYM AND I HAD TO THROW HIM UPSIDE DOWN AND PERFORM BACK THRUSTS TO DISLODGE IT FROM HIS AIRWAY. LUCKILY AFTER SEVERAL TRIES IT CAME OUT AND HE COULD BREATHE AGAIN. 
I AM AN AMATEUR CARPENTER, SO I KNOW NUTS AND BOLTS SO TO SAY, AND UPON INSPECTION AFTER THE INCIDENT I CAN TELL THAT THE INCLUDED NUT AND BARREL BOLT USED TO FASTEN THE ARMS OF THE PLAY GYM ARE NOT COMPATIBLE FOR A TIGHT CONNECTION. THIS IS BECAUSE EVEN WHEN THREADED COMPLETELY INTO THE NUT, THE BOLT STILL WRIGGLES SLIGHTLY IN PLACE. THIS MEANS THAT THERE IS SPACE IN THE THREADS AND SO IT LACKS THE TENSION REQUIRED TO NORMALLY KEEP HARDWARE FROM LOOSENING ON ITS OWN, WHICH IT WILL EASILY DO FROM EVEN LIGHT HANDLING/MOVEMENT SUCH AS A CHILD PULLING ON THE DANGLING ROPE ACCESSORIES, OR FROM A PARENT MOVING THE GYM AROUND. I HAD FERVENTLY TIGHTENED THE INCLUDED HARDWARE WHEN I FIRST ASSEMBLED THE GYM PER THE INSTRUCTIONS, AND IT ONLY TOOK A FEW WEEKS FOR THE BOLT PIECES TO POP BACK OUT AND NEARLY CHOKE MY CHILD TO DEATH. I WAS EXTREMELY LUCKY TO HAVE INTERVENED BEFORE IT COULD HAVE BEEN WORSE, HAD HE SWALLOWED IT COMPLETELY OR ASPHYXIATED, AND I HOPE THIS COMPANY WILL WARN OTHER PARENTS WHO ALREADY HAVE HIS PLAY GYM ABOUT THE HARDWARE AND ALSO WORK TO REPLACE THE PIECES WITH ONES THAT WON'T UNTHREAD THEMSELVES AND BECOME CHOKING HAZARDS.

WE RECENTLY ENCOUNTERED A DANGEROUS SITUATION WITH AN HP PAVILION NOTEBOOK/LAPTOP (MODEL 15-AW053NR) THAT NEARLY RESULTED IN AN EXPLOSION, FIRE, AND PERSONAL INJURY. DURING NORMAL USE, THE HP NOTEBOOK BEGAN TO AUTOMATICALLY CHARGE ITS INTERNAL BATTERY WHICH HAD BEEN LATENTLY DEGRADING UNBEKNOWNST TO THE CONSUMER. THIS RESULTED IN A LOUD POP, A CRACKED NOTEBOOK CASE AND A RUPTURED LITHIUM ION CELL. THE CONSUMER HAD JUST SECONDS TO UNPLUG THE NOTEBOOK AND PLACE IT ON A NON-FLAMMABLE SURFACE; OTHERWISE A BURN, FIRE, OR EXPLOSION LIKELY WOULD HAVE RESULTED. SINCE 2016, INTERNAL LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES MADE FOR HEWLETT PACKARD DEVICES HAVE BEEN AFFECTED BY SEVERAL INHERENT DESIGN AND MANUFACTURING ISSUES THAT SUBSTANTIALLY AFFECT THE SAFETY OF CONSUMERS. ELECTROCUTION AND EXPLOSION HAZARD ON GENERAL ELECTRIC GAS OVEN/STOVE MODEL JGBS66EEK1ES. GAS OVEN/STOVE HAS LINE AND NEUTRAL WIRES IMPROPERLY INSTALLED AT FACTORY TO THE IGNITOR/SPARK MODULE.  THIS MISWIRE CAUSED TWO DANGEROUS CONDITIONS, THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN MITIGATED, HAD THE UNIT BEEN PROPERLY ASSEMBLED AT FACTORY. THE VIOLET LINE WIRE WAS PLUGGED INTO THE NEUTRAL POSITION ON THE SPARK MODULE, WITH THE WHITE NEUTRAL WIRE PLUGGED INTO THE LINE POSITION ON THE MODULE. THE REAR COVER HOLDING THIS MODULE WAS REMOVED FOR INSPECTION AND CLEANING. THE WIRE CONNECTED TO THE NEUTRAL POSITION OF THE SPARK MODULE BECAME UNPLUGGED, RESTING INSIDE THE CHASSIS. THE COVER WAS REINSTALLED WITHOUT NOTING THIS LOOSE WIRE, AND AN ATTEMPT WAS MADE TO IGNITE THE STOVE FROM THE KNOB. THIS ENERGIZED THE DISCONNECTED LINE WIRE, WHICH CONTACTED THE OVEN CHASSIS/GROUND. THIS CREATED THE FIRST HAZARD, ELECTROCUTION THRU THE BODY OF THE OVEN. AS THE OVEN WAS ON A AFCI CIRCUIT BREAKER IN THE HOUSE, IT DID TRIP PROPERLY. THE SECOND HAZARD WAS THAT WITH THIS LINE WIRE DISCONNECTED, THE SPARK MODULE WAS INOP, AND TURNING THE KNOB FURTHER ALLOWED GAS FLOW WITHOUT IGNITION. 

IF THIS SPARK MODULE WAS WIRED PROPERLY, THE WIRE THAT BECAME DISCONNECTED BY REMOVING THE REAR COVER, WOULD HAVE BEEN A NEUTRAL WIRE, CARRYING NO VOLTAGE. THIS WOULD HAVE PREVENTED THE ELECTROCUTION HAZARD, AND THE SPARK MODULE MAY HAVE POTENTIALLY REMAINED FUNCTIONAL, USING THE GROUND WIRE AS A RETURN PATH, PREVENTING FREEFLOWING GAS WITHOUT A SPARK. THIS MAY STILL HAVE TRIPPED THE AFCI/GFCI BREAKER, WHICH WOULD ALERT THE USER TO A PROBLEM. 

THE POSITIONING OF THE SPARK MODULE ALLOWS FOR (IF APPROPRIATELY INSTALLED) NEUTRAL WIRE TO CATCH ON THE PANEL BELOW IT ON REMOVAL. 

THIS WIRING REVERSAL WAS VERIFIED BY COMPARING IT TO THE WIRING DIAGRAM TAPED TO THE REAR OF THE APPLIANCE, AND VOLTAGE TESTS.

UPDATED ON 5/29/2024: [AFTER CORRECTING THE PROBLEM IDENTIFIED IN THIS REPORT, (REVERSED NEUTRAL AND LINE WIRES) THE GAS STOVETOP HAS A MORE POWERFUL IGNITION SPARK. BEFORE THE COVER WAS INITIALLY REMOVED FOR CLEANING, AND THROUGHOUT THE LIFE OF THE UNIT, THE BURNERS WOULD OFTEN FAIL TO LIGHT UNTIL THE KNOBS WERE TURNED ALMOST PAST THE IGNITE PORTION OF THE KNOB. IT IS MEASURABLE WITH A MULTIMETER AND AN OSCILLOSCOPE.  I HAVE PERSONALLY HAD MORE THAN ONE OF THESE DEVICES THAT HAVE DONE THIS, AND THERE ARE (AFTER SOME LIGHT RESEARCH) SIMILAR COMPLAINTS ONLINE AND IN MY SOCIAL CIRCLE.  WHEN IN USE IT GIVE A CONSTANT OSCILLATING VOLTAGE THAT IS PASSED INTO POINTS OF CONTACT, SUCH AS YOUR HANDS.  IT STARTS AS A TINGLE OR PULSING, WHICH TURNS UNCOMFORTABLE THE LONGER YOU USE IT. IT CAUSES DISCOMFORT AND TINGLING, EITHER STINGING OR NUMBNESS DURING SHORT TERM USE LIKE A PHONE CALL, AND WHEN USED LONGER IT LEADS TO MUSCLE CONTRACTIONS, A BURNING/ FROSTBITE LIKE FEELING IN THE HANDS, ARMS, ETC, LOSS OF TACTILE FUNCTION, AS WELL AS LOCALIZED SWELLING IN MY SITUATION (I HAVE PHOTOS) THAT TAKES DAYS TO SUBSIDE, EVEN IF/ WHEN YOU STOP USING THE PHONE.  THERE IS ALSO A STEADY DRAINAGE OF THE BATTERY AS THIS OCCURS WHICH CAUSES THE PHONE TO NOT FUNCTION AS IT SHOULD IN TERMS OF CHARGE TIME (BUT THAT IS A NON-CONCERN IN COMPARISON) . IT ALSO GETS EXTREMELY HOT.
APPLE REFUSES TO ACKNOWLEDGE THE ISSUE AND CLAIMS IT IS STATIC ELECTRICITY WHEN YOU FIRST COMPLAIN.  IF YOU PURSUE THE ISSUE THEY CONTINUE TO DENY IT IS HAPPENING EVEN THOUGH EMPLOYEES AT THE APPLE STORE (AND MANY OTHER INDIVIDUALS) CAN FEEL IT HAPPENING WITH THE DEFECTIVE DEVICES.  MY FIRST PHONE TO DO THIS WAS EVENTUALLY REPLACED WHEN IT BECAME SUCH A PROBLEM THAT IT STARTED CREATING ERRORS IN THE PHONES FUNCTION.  IT WAS REPLACED WITH THE SAME MODEL, AND THE NEW ONE DOES EXACTLY THE SAME.  WHEN REPORTED TO APPLE I WAS TOLD IT CANT HAPPEN, ESPECIALLY TWICE, DESPITE MY FIRST DEVICE BEING REPLACED FOR EXACTLY THIS ISSUE.  APPLE CUSTOMER SUPPORT REFUSES TO ACKNOWLEDGE THE ISSUE, EXCEPT FOR THOSE WHO WILL SAY IT IS AN ACCEPTED ISSUE WITHIN THEIR THRESHOLD OF RISK.  THE ASSOCIATED RISK OF HAVING ELECTRICITY TRANSFER FROM MY PHONE TO MY BODY IN A WAY THAT CAUSES DISCOMFORT AND TACTILE PROBLEMS SHOULD BE ZERO.  THEIR SOLUTION IS TO PURCHASE A HEAVIER CASE OR A DIFFERENT MODEL OR BRAND OF  PHONE.  I SHOULDNT HAVE TO PURCHASE AN ACCESSORY OR ANYTHING ELSE TO NOT BE HURT BY MY PHONE. ESPECIALLY WHEN I AM ALREADY USING A SILICONE CASE FROM APPLE, A GLASS SCREEN PROTECTOR, AND THEIR MAG SAFE CHARGING SYSTEM WITH A SURGE PROTECTOR FOR EXTRA CAUTION.  THIS HAS BEEN HAPPENING SINCE RECEIVING MY FIRST OF THIS MODEL IN JANUARY 2024  AND IS CURRENTLY STILL HAPPENING. MY FIRST PHONE WAS REPLACED ON MAY 27TH 2024.  IT SHOULD ALSO BE NOTED THAT THIS PROBLEM DOES NOT FALL UNDER THEIR LIMITED WARRANTY, AS PER CUSTOMER SERVICE.

I AM A FIRE INVESTIGATOR AND WAS CALLED TO INVESTIGATE A PAST FIRE INCIDENT CONCERNING AN OVER THE RANGE MICROWAVE APPLIANCE.  THE OCCUPANT HAD RETURNED HOME AND NOTICED A BURNING PLASTIC SMELL IN THE APARTMENT.  THEY THEN FOUND A SMALL FIRE IN THE MICROWAVE, WHICH WAS NOT IN USE AT THE TIME.  THEY DESCRIBED THAT WHEN THEY OPENED THE DOOR TO THE MICROWAVE, THE ISSUE STOPPED.  WHEN THEY SHUT THE DOOR, THE MICROWAVE MADE A BUZZING OR HUMMING SOUND AND STARTED BURNING AGAIN.  THEY OPENED THE DOOR BACK UP TO MAKE IT STOP AND THEN CALLED MAINTENANCE.  THEY LATER DETERMINED THAT IT WAS ELECTRICAL ARCING/SPARKING.  THEY RECALLED THAT THE MICROWAVE HAD ARCED IN THE PAST AS WELL.  THEY STATED THAT THE MICROWAVE WAS LAST USED BY THEIR BABYSITTER TO WARM UP A BOTTLE APPROXIMATELY 20 MINUTES BEFORE THEY GOT HOME AND NOTICED THE SMELL AND FIRE INSIDE THE MICROWAVE.  

I VISITED THE APARTMENT TO INVESTIGATE THE ISSUE ON 6/18/24.  I OBSERVED SOOT AND HEAT DAMAGE ON THE GLASS TURNTABLE IN THE MICROWAVE THAT HAD CAUSED SEVERAL SECTIONS OF TURNTABLE TO CRACK AND BREAK OFF.  THE PLASTIC ROLLER THAT THE TURNTABLE SETS UPON HAD AN AREA THAT HAD BURNED AWAY.  THERE WAS SOOT STAINING ON THE BOTTOM OF THE MICROWAVE COMPARTMENT, AND MINOR SOOT DEPOSITS ON THE BACK WALL OF THE COOKING COMPARTMENT.  IT APPEARED THAT THE FIRE OCCURRED BETWEEN THE GLASS TURNTABLE AND THE BOTTOM OF THE COOKING COMPARTMENT.  THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE OF ANY FOOD OR OTHER MATERIALS IN THE MICROWAVE OR IN THE FIRE DEBRIS IN THE BOTTOM.  THE ONLY MATERIALS PRESENT WERE PARTS OF THE MICROWAVE.  I ALSO FOUND THE MICROWAVE TO BE RELATIVELY CLEAN AND WITHOUT EXCESSIVE GREASE OR FOOD REMNANTS.  

THE OCCUPANT PLUGGED THE MICROWAVE BACK IN AND I OBSERVED THAT IT APPEARED FINE WHEN THE DOOR WAS OPEN.  WHEN THE DOOR WAS CLOSED, THE MICROWAVE MADE A HUMMING SOUND AND THEN ELECTRICAL ARCING WAS OBSERVED ON THE BOTTOM OF THE COOKING COMPARTMENT NEAR ONE OF THE GLASS SHARDS FROM THE DAMAGED TURNTABLE.  THE MICROWAVE WAS UNPLUGGED AND THERE WAS NO FURTHER ACTIVITY.

I PURCHASED AN IRON ON AMAZON AND IT ARRIVED ON 5/31/24. TODAY, 6/1/24 I TOOK IT OUT TO USE IT. I FILLED IT WITH WATER BELOW THE MAX FILL LINE, PLUGGED IT IN, AND USED IT TO IRON TWO SHIRTS. IT DRIPPED WATER ALL OVER MY HARDWOOD FLOOR, IT SOAKED MY IRONING BOARD, AND IT SPUTTERED STEAMING WATER ALL OVER MY SHIRTS. MOST OF THE WATER LEAKED ONTO THE FLOOR, AND I THINK IT WAS FOR THE MOST PART ROOM TEMPERATURE, BUT I DID FEEL SOME SPLATTERS (SMALL DROPLETS OF WATER) FROM THE IMPACT ONTO THE FLOOR, AND THEY FELT HOT TO ME (I WAS BAREFOOT AT THE TIME). THE IRON IS ALSO VERY LIGHTWEIGHT, EVEN WITH WATER IN IT. THIS, COUPLED WITH THE FACT THAT IT DOES NOT STAND WELL ON THE IRONING BOARD BECAUSE ITS CORD IS AWKWARDLY PLACED, MEANS THAT IT FEELS LIKELY TO TIP OVER. BECAUSE OF THE AWKWARDLY PLACED CORD, THE ONLY WAY TO SIT THE IRON UPRIGHT IS TO PLACE IT RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF THE IRONING BOARD, WITH THE CORD DRAPED OVER THE END. THIS MAKES IT EVEN MORE LIKELY TO FALL. IF YOU READ SOME OF THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS FOR THIS PRODUCT ON AMAZON, YOU WILL SEE THAT AT LEAST ONE PERSON HAS BEEN BURNED FROM TRYING TO CATCH THE IRON AS IT WAS FALLING. THEIR REVIEW IS TITLED "DANGEROUS" AND FRANKLY I AGREE WITH THEM. I DON'T TRUST THIS PRODUCT NOT TO BURN ME WITH SCALDING WATER AND I'M SURE IT WOULD HAVE EVENTUALLY FALLEN OFF MY IRONING BOARD HAD I CONTINUED USING IT, POTENTIALLY BURNING MY LEGS OR FEET.

U-SKOOTER/E-TWOW DANGEROUS SUDDEN FREEZE UP OF FRONT WHEEL PURCHASED ONLINE FROM: 
ETWOW.COM

SHORTLY BEFORE NOON ON MAY 22, 2024, [REDACTED] WAS RIDING HER U-SCOOTER/E-TWOW ON [REDACTED]. SHE WAS ON HER WAY TO THE [REDACTED] STATION AS PART OF HER DAILY COMMUTE TO WORK. SHE HAD BEEN DRIVING THIS ROUTE FOR OVER A YEAR WITHOUT INCIDENT.
SUDDENLY, THE FRONT WHEEL OF THE SCOOTER LOCKED. BEFORE [REDACTED] COULD REACT, SHE WAS THROWN OVER THE HANDLEBARS AND ONTO THE ROAD. SHE SUSTAINED A BROKEN ORBITAL BONE, A LACERATION OVER HER RIGHT EYE, AND ROAD RASH/SOFT TISSUE DAMAGE ON HER HIP, HER RIGHT FOREARM AND BOTH KNEES.
 THANKFULLY, SHE WAS WEARING A HELMET, BUT THE DAMAGE TO HER FACE WAS SEVERE AND PARAMEDICS TRANSPORTED HER TO [REDACTED]. HER PAIN WAS SO INTENSE THAT, IN THE AMBULANCE, PARAMEDICS ADMINISTERED TWO DOSES OF FENTANYL.
AT THE HOSPITAL, [REDACTED] UNDERWENT A FULL CT SCAN AND X-RAYS, WHICH IDENTIFIED THE BROKEN ORBITAL BONE IN HER FACE. IN ADDITION, SHE WAS GIVEN MORPHINE AND OXYCODONE TO DEAL WITH HER SEVERE PAIN. SHE SPENT SEVEN HOURS IN THE TRAUMA WARD OF THE HOSPITAL BEFORE BEING RELEASED. AS A RESULT OF THE ACCIDENT, SHE MISSED SEVERAL DAYS OF WORK AND CONTINUES TO EXPERIENCE DEBILITATION AND PAIN FROM HER INJURIES. IT MAY BE MONTHS BEFORE SHE IS BACK TO NORMAL.
 UPON DOING SOME BASIC [REDACTED], [REDACTED] DISCOVERED THAT OTHER ETWOW SCOOTER USERS HAVE EXPERIENCED THE SAME PRODUCT FLAW THAT RESULTED IN HER CRASH.  HERE IS THE REFERENCE TO OTHERS EXPERIENCING THIS PRODUCT FLAW:  
[REDACTED]
THE SCOOTER HAS NOT BEEN TURNED ON SINCE THE CRASH. [REDACTED] HAS PHOTOS OF HER INJURIES AND DOCUMENTATION FROM THE HOSPITAL AS WELL.
THE FRONT MOTOR WHEEL DOES NOT BEHAVE LIKE A NORMAL WHEEL.  WHEN THE SCOOTER IS OFF THERE IS A LOT OF RESISTANCE TO THE SPIN.  SO WHEN THE BATTERY DIES, I WALK THE SCOOTER INSTEAD OF RIDING IT MANUALLY BECAUSE OF THIS MOTOR WHEEL RESISTANCE.  IT HAS BEEN THIS WAY SINCE I TOOK THE SCOOTER OUT OF THE BOX AND I BELIEVE IS A NORMAL PART OF THE DESIGN.  I THINK THIS DESIGN IS PERHAPS WHY THERE ARE PROBLEMS WITH THE FRONT "WHEEL LOCKING".  IF I'M GOING 30MPH AND SUDDENLY A FUSE BLOWS (OR SOMETHING), MY WHEEL MOTOR WILL DIE AND GO INTO ITS STATE OF RESISTANCE.  THE RESISTANCE AT HIGH SPEED COULD BE CREATING THE SENSATION OF "WHEEL LOCK".

HERE IS [REDACTED] DESCRIPTION OF THE ACCIDENT:
I WAS COMMUTING TO WORK ON MY USUAL ROUTE IN THE BIKE LANE, ALERT AS ALWAYS ON THE LOOKOUT FOR POTHOLES AND DEBRIS. SUDDENLY MY FRONT MOTOR WHEEL LOCKED AND I WAS THROWN FORWARD ONTO THE PAVEMENT. I WAS GOING ROUGHLY 25MPH DOWN AN OVERPASS. THOUGH IT HAPPENED IN A MANNER OF SECONDS, I WAS AWARE THAT THIS INCIDENT WAS CAUSED BY THE FRONT WHEEL LOCKING UP. I HEARD A NOISE THAT I AM FAMILIAR WITH, A NOISE MADE BY THE REGENERATIVE BRAKING SYSTEM WHEN IT IS ENGAGED. BUT I WAS NOT PUSHING THE BRAKE LEVER. THEN I HEARD AND FELT THE FRONT MOTOR WHEEL SKID ON THE PAVEMENT. THE HANDLEBARS WERE FACING PERFECTLY FORWARD THROUGHOUT THIS AND I WAS LAUNCHED HEAD-FIRST OVER THEM. THE FIRST THING I SAW AFTER HITTING THE PAVEMENT WAS BLOOD DRIPPING FROM MY EYE ONTO THE PAVEMENT. I COULD HARDLY BREATHE FROM THE PAIN AND SHOCK. A MAN PULLED OVER AND ENGAGED ME IN CONCERNED QUESTIONS. HE GAVE ME A CLEAN WASHCLOTH TO APPLY PRESSURE TO MY BLEEDING EYE. I WAS WRITHING IN PAIN BUT CONSCIOUS. A SECOND MAN WALKED OVER AND I WATCHED HIM FETCH MY SCOOTER THAT WAS ON ITS SIDE SPINNING IN CIRCLES IN THE MIDDLE OF THE ROAD. I HAVE BONE FRAGMENTS STILL FLOATING NEAR MY ELBOW AND REMAIN IN PAIN NEARLY A MONTH LATER.  I LOVE THE IDEA OF THIS TRIKE.  I LOVE THAT I'M ABLE TO RIDE WITH MY HUSBAND.  I JUST WANT A STABLE AND RELIABLE RIDE. ON SATURDAY, 06 JULY 2024, I WAS OPERATING MY JET JPS-10TS TABLE SAW WHEN, DURING THE MIDDLE OF A CUT, THE MOTOR WHICH POWERS THE SAW BLADE STOPPED WORKING. LOOKED AT THE ONLINE INSTRUCTION MANUAL AND FOUND THE NEED TO PRESS THERMAL RESET SWITCH ON MOTOR WHICH IS INSIDE CAVITY OF SAW.  PRESSED BUTTON, HEARD A CLICK, WENT BACK TO FRONT OF SAW AND PRESSED THE "ON" BUTTON TO COMPLETE MY CUT.  LATER THAN DAY, THE SAME THING OCCURRED, AND THE MOTOR STALLED MID-CUT.  REACHED INSIDE SAW CAVITY TO PRESS RESET BUTTON, HEARD THE CLICK, AND THE SAW IMMEDIATELY STARTED.  THE BLADE MADE CONTACT WITH MY RIGHT HAND AND CUT THE RIGHT PINKY FINGER.  THANKFULLY I WAS ABLE TO REMOVE MY HAND FROM THE SAW CAVITY BEFORE ANY FURTHER DAMAGE OCCURRED.  THE OUTSIDE EDGE OF MY RIGHT PINKY HAD LOST A SMALL AREA OF SKIN (1/4" BY 1/4") AND BLED PROFUSELY.  FORTUNATELY, NO HOSPITAL VISIT WAS REQUIRED, HOWEVER IT TOOK NEARLY 24 HOURS FOR THE BLEEDING TO STOP.  ON TUESDAY 09 JULY, I CONTACTED MANUFACTURER TO ASK WHY THE SAW IMMEDIATELY RESTARTED AFTER PRESSING THE RESET SWITCH AND TO LET THEM KNOW I RECEIVED A MINOR INJURY. THE JET REPRESENTATIVE WAS ABLE TO LOOK UP THE MACHINE IN HIS DATABASE AND DETERMINED THE THERMAL RESET SWITCH FOR MOTOR IS MECHANICAL.  THIS, WHEN THE RESET BUTTON IS PRESSED POWER WILL IMMEDIATELY START THE MOTOR AND SPIN THE BLADE. WHEN I ASKED WHY THIS DID NOT OCCUR THE FIRST TIME THE SAW MOTOR STALLED, THE REPRESENTATIVE SAID THAT BECAUSE THE RESET SWITCH IN MECHANICAL AND NOT MAGNETIC, THE ON/OFF SWITCH NEEDS TO BE POWERED OFF BEFORE PRESSING THE RESET SWITCH. THERE IS NOTHING IN THE OWNER'S MANUAL WHICH GIVES INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PROCESS TO RESET THE MOTOR.  THE MANUAL (SECTION 9.3) STATES: "IF THE SAW BECOMES OVERLOADED AND THE MOTOR SHUTS OFF, PUSH THE RESET BUTTON ON THE MOTOR JUNCTION BOX (B, FIGURE 21) TO RESTART."  HOWEVER, ON THE SAW I OWN, THERE IS NO MOTOR JUNCTION BOX.  THE RESET SWITCH IS LOCATED ON THE ACTUAL MOTOR WHICH SITS APPROXIMATELY 4 INCHES FROM THE BLADE.  I DID ASK IF THERE WAS A MAGNETIC RESET SWITCH AVAILABLE (WHICH WOULD AUTOMATICALLY TURN THE SAW POWER OFF) AND WAS TOLD THE NEWER MODELS HAVE THEM BUT THE ONE I HAVE (MADE IN 2016) DOES NOT. I THEN ASKED ABOUT REPLACING THE ENTIRE MOTOR AND SWITCH ASSEMBLY WITH THE NEW STYLE (WHICH PLACES THE RESET SWITCH ABOVE THE ON/OFF SWITCH AND ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE SAW CAVITY. THE REPRESENTATIVE SAID SINCE THE NEW SAW STYLE IS NOT EXACTLY THE SAME AS THE ONE I OWN, RETROFITTING WOULD NOT BE POSSIBLE.  THE REPRESENTATIVE SUGGESTED I COULD CONTACT AN ELECTRICIAN WHO MIGHT BE ABLE TO REWIRE THE SAW AND RELOCATE THE RESET SWITCH.  JET DOES NOT OFFER A TRADE IN POLICY TO PURCHASE THE UPGRADED MODEL WHICH HAS THE RESET SWITCH LOCATED IN A SAFER LOCATION AND A MAGNETIC STYLE SWITCH WHICH WILL CUT THE POWER SHOULD THE VOLTAGE DROP DURING USE.

BECAUSE OF THE ACTUAL LOCATION OF THE RESET SWITCH BEING SO CLOSE TO THE SAW BLADE, THIS REALLY IS A SAFETY HAZARD.  FURTHER, THE OWNER'S MANUAL INDICATES THE RESET SWITCH IS IN A DIFFERENT LOCATION THAN IT ACTUALLY IS AND MAKES NO MENTION OF A PROCESS TO SAFELY RESET THE SWITCH. DUE TO THE INJURY TO MYSELF, THERE IS A RISK THAT OTHERS MAY HAVE A SIMILAR OCCURRENCE WITH THE MOTOR SHUTTING OFF IN THE MIDDLE OF A CUT AND UPON PRESSING THE RESET SWITCH MAY HAVE A MORE SERIOUS INJURY THAN I RECEIVED.

THIS WAS A NEW BURST PROOF HOSE BOUGHT ON JUNE 2 THAT BURST WHILE IN USE ON  JULY 20.   NOT ONLY ARE THEY MAKING FALSE CLAIMS ABOUT THE QUALITY OF THEIR PRODUCT BUT IT ALSO BROKE MY SLIDING GLASS DOOR.   I FEEL LUCKY THAT I WAS ABLE TO REACT SO QUICKLY AS I FEEL IT COULD HAVE BEEN MUCH WORSE.   

  I WAS USING THE HOSE TO WATER SOME PLANTS. I  TURNED IT OFF AT THE INCLUDED CLOSE VALVE AND PLACED IT ON THEN GROUND FOR A MOMENT TO SPEAK TO FRIEND.   WHILE STANDING NEARBY CONVERSING WE HEARD AN ODD NOISE. I LOOKED OVER AND THE BLACK PLASTIC VALVE END HAD CRACKED SEPARATING INTO TWO PIECES. WHAT CAN ONLY BE DESCRIBED  AS LARGE BLUE TUMOR  RESEMBLING A WATER BALLOON BEGAN GROWING FROM SIDE OF HOSE. WE BOTH KNEW WHAT WAS GOING TO HAPPEN SO I RAN BACK TOWARDS THE HOUSE SPIGOT BUT DIDNT MAKE IT BEFORE THE HOSE BURST.   IT SOUNDED LIKE A GUN SHOOT IT WAS SO LOUD.  THE HOSE FLEW BACK AND SHATTERED THE SLIDER DOOR.

FIRE WAS DISPATCHED TO THE SCENE ALONG WITH AN AMBULANCE. THE FIRE FIGHTER SAID THE FEMALE WAS UNABLE TO EXIT ON HER OWN. TWO PEOPLE WERE DISPLACED DUE TO THE FIRE. THE FIREFIGHTER WHO LIVED IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD RESPONDED TO THE SCENE AND REPORTED A HOUSE APPLIANCE ON FIRE.

CREWS RESPONDED TO AN APARTMENT BUILDING FIRE. FIRE CREWS WERE ABLE TO LOCATE A FIRE IN A GROUND FLOOR APARTMENT. INSIDE, THEY FOUND ONE PERSON DEAD. IT IS BELIEVED THAT THE FIRE MAY HAVE STARTED IN THE KITCHEN AREA OF THE UNIT.

WHEN FIREFIGHTERS, EMS, & POLICE RESPONDED BEFORE NOON, 2 OF THE BUILDINGS WERE ENGULFED IN FLAMES. 3 PEOPLE WERE TAKEN TO THE HOSPITAL FOR NON-LIFE-THREATENING INJURIES. ALL CITY FIREFIGHTERS WERE CALLED. 4 HOMES WERE DAMAGED, DISPLACING 17. CAUSE OF THE FIRE WAS UNKNOWN.

AN OUTDOOR HEAT LAMP ON THE BACK PORCH BEING USED TO KEEP PETS WARM LIKELY STARTED A FIRE OUTSIDE A HOME. WHEN FIREFIGHTERS ARRIVED, THEY SAW THICK SMOKE COMING FROM THE HOME. TWO ADULTS AND TWO CHILDREN WERE ABLE TO SAFELY ESCAPE.

WE RECEIVED AN ALARM FROM AMAZON STATING THAT THE HUSH HUTTING MEMORY FOAM CRIB MATTRESS PURCHASED FROM THEIR PLATFORM DID NOT MEET MANDATORY SAFETY REGULATIONS AND POSED A SUBSTANTIAL PRODUCT HAZARD. THIS PROMPTED US TO INVESTIGATE FURTHER AS OUR NEWBORN SON, [REDACTED], HAD BEEN USING THIS MATTRESS SINCE HIS BIRTH.

WHAT TYPE OF PRODUCT(S) WERE BEING USED?
THE PRODUCT IN QUESTION IS THE HUSH HUTTING MEMORY FOAM CRIB MATTRESS, WATERPROOF TODDLER BED MATTRESS, PORTABLE BABY MATTRESSES FOR INFANT AND TODDLER WITH REMOVABLE BAMBOO MATTRESS COVER (52X28X2, WHITE).

WHO WAS USING THE PRODUCT(S)?
OUR NEWBORN SON, [REDACTED], BORN ON MAY 31, 2023, WAS USING THE MATTRESS.

HOW WERE THE PRODUCT(S) BEING USED?
THE MATTRESS WAS BEING USED AS INTENDED, AS A SLEEPING SURFACE FOR OUR INFANT SON IN HIS CRIB.

WERE THERE ANY INJURIES THAT HAPPENED OR MAY HAVE HAPPENED WHILE USING THE PRODUCT?
YES, OUR SON DEVELOPED HEALTH ISSUES, INCLUDING BREATHING AND RESPIRATORY DIFFICULTIES AND A PERSISTENT RASH. THESE SYMPTOMS WERE PREDOMINANTLY PRESENT WHEN HE SLEPT ON THE MATTRESS.

HOW DID ANY INJURIES OCCUR?
THE INJURIES OCCURRED GRADUALLY AS OUR SON CONTINUED TO SLEEP ON THE UNSAFE MATTRESS. DESPITE EXTENSIVE MEDICAL CONSULTATIONS, NO OTHER POTENTIAL CAUSES FOR THESE CONDITIONS WERE IDENTIFIED.

40 YO CONSUMER'S ELECTRIC WALL DOUBLE OVEN WAS CHIPPING OFF GLASS INTO FOOD.  A TECH STATED THAT WHOLE UNIT NEEDS TO BE REPLACED.  MANUFACTURER DID NOTHING.  CONSUMER, 35 YO AND 10 YO WERE NOT INJURED.

THE PRODUCT IN QUESTION RELATED TO THIS INCIDENT IS THE CHILLAXBABY GIRAFFE PRO MAX SMART 5" 1080P WI-FI VIDEO BABY MONITOR. UPC IS 860006639044 AND THE UNIQUE IDENTIFIER BARCODE ON THIS SPECIFIC PRODUCT INVOLVED IN THE INCIDENT IS DM685KC4B000126. MODEL IS DM685BU, FCC ID: 2AZ8M-BCX680, IC: 27169-BCX680, HVIN: BCX680. THIS PRODUCT WAS BEING USED BY US, AS CONSUMERS, AND AS INTENDED TO MONITOR OUR CHILD WHILE HE IS SLEEPING IN HIS CRIB. WE HAD BEEN USING THE PRODUCT DAILY FOR ALMOST 8 WEEKS UNTIL THE DATE OF THE INCIDENT. WHAT HAPPENED: THE CAMERA WAS PLUGGED INTO AN ELECTRICAL OUTLET USING THE MANUFACTURER SUPPLIED POWER ADAPTER ON 7/12/2024 AT APPROXIMATELY 7:30PM. A SPARK WAS OBSERVED EMANATING FROM THE SLITS OF THE CAMERA PORTION OF THE PRODUCT AND THEN A BURNING ODOR WAS THEN OBSERVED SUBSEQUENT TO THE SPARK BEING SEEN. WE IMMEDIATELY UNPLUGGED THE CAMERA AND THE ODOR REMAINED. NO INJURIES OCCURRED WHILE USING THE PRODUCT BUT HAD WE NOT ACTED SWIFTLY THIS SPARK AND WHAT APPEARED TO BE BURNING ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS COULD HAVE LED TO A FIRE IN OUR APARTMENT. THIS IS A POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD. WE REACHED OUT TO THE PRODUCT MANUFACTURER ON 7/12/2024 SHORTLY AFTER THE INCIDENT OCCURRED. AS OF WRITING 11:39 AM EST 7/13/2024, WE HAVE NOT RECEIVED A RESPONSE FROM THE PRODUCT MANUFACTURER.

THIS DEVICE ALMOST CAUGHT FIRE OR DID CATCH FIRE IN A SMOLDERING MANNER, RELEASING TOXIC PLASTIC FUMES THROUGHOUT THE HOME TO WHICH PEOPLE WERE EXPOSED. A FIRE WAS VERY POSSIBLE IF THERE WAS ANY COMBUSTIBLE MATERIAL NEARBY, ESPECIALLY IF THE WOULD-BE-FIRE HAD NOT BEEN CAUGHT EARLY BY SOMEONE WITH A GOOD SENSE OF SMELL. THOSE WHO ARE NOT ABLE TO LOCATE OR INFER THE SOURCES OF SMELLS MAY BE MORE AT RISK OF DEATH, PROPERTY DAMAGE, OR HOMELESSNESS BY FIRE.

THE PRODUCT COMPRISES A USB-C CHARGING CABLE, USB-C MALE CHARGER WALL OUTLET ADAPTER, AND THE HANDHELD PRODUCT ITSELF COMPRISING OF A GRIPPABLE RECHARGEABLE BATTERY SUB-UNIT (AND A CUTTER-AND-FOIL-SHAVER SUB-UNIT). WHILE CHARGING WITH THE PROVIDED ADAPTER (WHICH HAS THE SAME VOLTAGE AND CURRENT MARKINGS AS THE BATTERY UNIT), THE BATTERY UNIT OVERHEATED DRASTICALLY, AND OVER THE COURSE OF HALF AN HOUR LEAKED PLASTIC FUMES THROUGHOUT THE BUILDING. A PREVIOUS PURCHASE OF THIS PRODUCT HAD SPORADICALLY-MALFUNCTIONING CHARGING, SO ONE CAN ONLY SURMISE THAT THE ISSUE IS SYSTEMIC WITH THIS MODEL, AND PERHAPS WITH THE MANUFACTURER THAT MANSCAPED IS WORKING WITH IN CHINA, AND RELATED CHARGING CIRCUITRY OF RELATED PRODUCTS.

[PRODUCT IDENTIFICATION TAG SHOWS MANUFACTURER AS ELECTROLUX HOME PRODUCTS, INC., CHARLOTTE, NC 28262; SERIAL # TH30978187; MODEL # FFID2426TS6A]. WE BEGAN USING THE NEW DISHWASHER STARTING AT THE END OF AUGUST 2023 WHEN WE MOVED INTO THE HOUSE. WE REGULARLY SMELLED AN ODOR OF BURNING PLASTIC WHEN USING THE DISHWASHER BUT COULD NEVER IDENTIFY THE ROOT CAUSE, WHICH WAS NOT EVIDENT. IN THE PAST 7 TO 10 OR 12 DAYS, THE DISHWASHER BEGAN LEAKING FROM THE BASE OF IT WHEN OPERATING. WE TRIED TO TROUBLESHOOT AND WERE UNABLE TO DETERMINE THE CAUSE. TODAY, OUR HOME'S BUILDER CAME OUT TO HELP TROUBLESHOOT THE DISHWASHER. HE FOUND THAT WATER WAS LEAKING FROM THE DISHWASHER WHEN IT WAS OPERATING, AND OBSERVED WATER FALLING ON THE FLOOR (AFTER THE DISHWASHER'S FRONT LOW KICK PLATE WAS REMOVED). AFTER FURTHER TESTING, THE BUILDER AND I NOTICED THAT ONE SECTION OF THE HEATING ELEMENT INSIDE THE DISHWASHER AT THE BASE OF THE APPLIANCE, WAS TOUCHING AND IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE DISHWASHER'S INTERIOR PLASTIC IN ONE SECTION, HAD MELTED THE PLASTIC, AND THE HEATING ELEMENT WAS FUSED TO THE PLASTIC. THIS IS A VERY DANGEROUS CONDITION AND COULD HAVE CAUSED A FIRE. AS IT IS, THE LEAKING WATER FROM THE DISHWASHER, HAS CAUSED WATER DAMAGE TO A SECTION OF OUR NEW HOME'S HARDWOOD FLOORS, CAUSING A SECTION OF THE FLOOR TO SWELL UP, LIFT, AND SEPARATE FROM OTHER BOARDS. WITH OUR BUILDER, WE CUT OFF THE POWER TO THE DISHWASHER AND THE WATER SUPPLY LINE AND HAVE STOPPED USING THE DISHWASHER EFFECTIVE TODAY AND HENCEFORTH. THIS FRIGIDAIRE BRAND DISHWASHER MANUFACTURED BY ELECTROLUX HOME PRODUCTS, IS A DANGER ANYWHERE IT HAS BEEN SOLD.
MY HUSBAND DID A [REDACTED] SEARCH TODAY AFTER WE DISCOVERED THIS ISSUE, AND FOUND THAT ELECTROLUX WAS SUED UNDER A CLASS ACTION IN U.S. DISTRICT COURT FOR THE WESTERN DISTRICT OF NORTH CAROLINA ON OR AROUND NOVEMBER 15, 2012 BY LEAD PLAINTIFFS [REDACTED] AND THAT, "...ELECTROLUX DESIGNED, MANUFACTURED, AND MARKETED DISHWASHERS...THAT CONTAIN A SERIOUS AND DANGEROUS DEFECT, PUTTING MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS IN HARM'S WAY."
AS CONSUMERS WITH NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE, OWNERSHIP OR USE OF A FRIGIDAIRE DISHWASHER PRIOR TO PURCHASING THIS NEW HOUSE IN JUNE 2023, WE ARE SHOCKED THAT THERE IS PRIOR LEGAL PRECEDENT ABOUT DANGEROUS ELECTROLUX DISHWASHERS FROM 12 YEARS AGO.

NEXT THING I KNOW THE STOCK IS BOILING OVER SO I REMOVE THE POT FROM THE BURNER. AFTER SOME TIME, I TESTED TO SEE IF THIS WAS STILL AN ISSUE BY CLOSING THE BREAKER AGAIN BUT THE BURNER IMMEDIATELY TURNED BACK ON WITHOUT ME PUSHING THE ON BUTTON ON THE CONTROL PANEL. 

THIS IS THE SECOND TIME I'VE EXPERIENCED THIS.  THE FIRST TIME, BACK IN 2017, WAS A VERY SIMILAR SITUATION DESCRIBED ABOVE. AS SOON AS THE COAX WAS CONNECTED, AGAIN WITH THE SONY TV UNPLUGGED, THE COAX STARTED TO SMOKE AND AGAIN, THE CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED.  BASED ON MY OBSERVATIONS OF THE CABLE MELTING BEHIND THE WALL PLATE AS WELL AS IN THE CRAWL SPACE, THE FAULT THAT THIS SONY TV HAS DEVELOPED POSES A SIGNIFICANT RISK OF FIRE.

I AM REPORTING A SERIOUS SAFETY ISSUE WITH THE ONEWHEEL, A PERSONAL ELECTRIC MOBILITY DEVICE MANUFACTURED BY FUTURE MOTION. I EXPERIENCED TWO SIGNIFICANT CRASHES WHILE USING THE PRODUCT, RESULTING IN PHYSICAL INJURIES AND LOSS OF CONFIDENCE IN THE PRODUCTS SAFETY.

**INCIDENT 1:**

I WAS RIDING THE ONEWHEEL OVER WET CONCRETE, NAVIGATING SHALLOW PUDDLES AS INTENDED FOR OUTDOOR USE. WHILE TRAVELING AT APPROXIMATELY 15 MPH, THE BOARDS SELF-BALANCING SYSTEM SUDDENLY STOPPED WORKING. THE NOSE OF THE BOARD DOVE INTO THE GROUND, THROWING ME FORWARD ONTO MY RIGHT SIDE. I SUSTAINED ROAD RASH ON MY LEG, HAND, ARM, AND SHOULDER, AND A BROKEN ARM. MY HELMET ALSO CRACKED UPON IMPACT. AFTER THE CRASH, THE BOARD WAS UNRESPONSIVE AND HAD CONDENSATION INSIDE THE CASING, INDICATING WATER HAD ENTERED THE CONTROL BOARD. THE ONEWHEEL IS MARKETED AS AN OUTDOOR PRODUCT, AND FAILURE IN SUCH CONDITIONS RAISES SERIOUS SAFETY CONCERNS.

**INCIDENT 2:**

AFTER PAYING $180 TO SHIP THE BOARD BACK TO FUTURE MOTION FOR REPAIRS, I RECEIVED IT AND RODE IT ONCE. DURING THAT RIDE, WHILE STOPPED AT A RED LIGHT, THE BOARD UNEXPECTEDLY ACCELERATED ON ITS OWN WITHOUT ANY INPUT FROM ME. THERE WAS NO HAPTIC BUZZ, PUSHBACK, OR OTHER INDICATION THAT THE BOARD WOULD ACCELERATE. THIS MALFUNCTION THREW ME OFF THE BOARD, RE-INJURING MY ALREADY BROKEN ARM AND FURTHERING MY DISTRUST IN THE PRODUCT. I HAD ONLY RIDDEN THE BOARD A SHORT DISTANCE AFTER RECEIVING IT FROM FUTURE MOTIONS REPAIR SHOP.

**PRODUCT INFORMATION:**

THE PRODUCT IS A PERSONAL ELECTRIC MOBILITY DEVICE KNOWN AS A "ONEWHEEL," WHICH IS DESIGNED FOR OUTDOOR USE ON VARIOUS TERRAINS. IT WAS BEING USED BY ME, AN EXPERIENCED RIDER, IN EVERYDAY OUTDOOR CONDITIONS.

**INJURIES:**

BOTH INCIDENTS RESULTED IN PHYSICAL INJURIES. THE FIRST INCIDENT CAUSED ROAD RASH AND A BROKEN ARM, WHILE THE SECOND CRASH REACTIVATED MY PREVIOUS INJURIES. THE SECOND INCIDENT HIGHLIGHTS AN ONGOING ISSUE WITH THE PRODUCTS RELIABILITY, POSING A SERIOUS RISK OF FURTHER INJURY.

**CONCLUSION:**

THESE INCIDENTS SUGGEST THAT THE ONEWHEEL HAS SIGNIFICANT SAFETY FLAWS. THE FIRST CRASH WAS DUE TO WATER EXPOSURE DESPITE CLAIMS THAT IT IS BUILT FOR OUTDOOR USE, WHILE THE SECOND CRASH OCCURRED AFTER THE BOARD HAD BEEN SERVICED BY THE MANUFACTURER. GIVEN THE PHYSICAL INJURIES IVE EXPERIENCED, THIS PRODUCT PRESENTS A SERIOUS RISK TO CONSUMERS.

AT FIRST I ASSUMED THAT THE BRAKE CABLE MUST HAVE SNAPPED OR SOMETHING, BUT THAT DOESN'T SEEM TO HAVE BEEN THE CASE BECAUSE EACH TIME I PULLED THE REAR BRAKE LEVER I COULD SEE THE CABLE PULLING THE LITTLE "ARM" (NOT SURE WHAT THIS PART IS CALLED, BUT IT'S THE LITTLE LEVER ON THE BRAKE ITSELF THAT THE CABLE CONNECTS TO) BEING PULLED WHAT SEEMS TO BE THE NORMAL AMOUNT.

LOOKING INTO THE REAR CALIPER AND PULLING THE HANDLE, I COULD SEE A SMALL AMOUNT OF PAD MOVEMENT, AND COULD EVEN SEE THE ROTOR MOVE A BIT SO I KNOW THAT SOME CONTACT WAS BEING MADE. BUT JUST A SHORT DISTANCE INTO PULLING THE BRAKE I WOULD HEAR THAT SAME PING/CLICK/POP SOUND AND IT APPEARS THAT THE BRAKE WOULD JUST POP/SLIP BACK OFF, MY HAND WOULD FEEL ALMOST NO RESISTANCE ON THE LEVER, AND THE BRAKES WERE BARELY STOPPING THE BIKE, IF AT ALL!

I AM WRITING TO URGENTLY REQUEST THE ADDITION OF A WARNING LABEL ON ALL PRESCRIPTION BOTTLES THAT ARE NOT FULLY CHILDPROOF. AS A MOTHER, I RECENTLY HAD A FRIGHTENING EXPERIENCE INVOLVING MY 2-YEAR-OLD DAUGHTER, BORN ON JULY 2, 2022, WHO MANAGED TO OPEN A PRESCRIPTION BOTTLE IN A MATTER OF SECONDS. I HAD ASSUMED THE BOTTLE WAS CHILDPROOF, AS MANY PARENTS DO, BUT THIS INCIDENT MADE ME REALIZE THAT CRITICAL INFORMATION REGARDING THE SAFETY OF THESE CONTAINERS IS NOT CLEARLY COMMUNICATED TO CONSUMERS.

THE U.S. CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION (CPSC) IS RESPONSIBLE FOR ENFORCING THE POISON PREVENTION PACKAGING ACT (PPPA) OF 1970, WHICH MANDATES CHILD-RESISTANT PACKAGING FOR MOST ORAL PRESCRIPTION MEDICATIONS. HOWEVER, CHILD-RESISTANT DOES NOT MEAN CHILDPROOF. IF THE PACKAGING CANNOT FULLY PREVENT ACCESS BY CHILDREN, THERE MUST BE A CLEAR WARNING LABEL ON THE CAP OR BOTTLE, INFORMING PARENTS AND CAREGIVERS OF THIS RISK. 

WITHOUT SUCH WARNINGS, MANY CONSUMERS, INCLUDING MYSELF, BELIEVE THESE BOTTLES ARE SAFER THAN THEY ACTUALLY ARE. MY PERSONAL EXPERIENCE INVOLVED PLACING MY PURSE, CONTAINING MY PRESCRIPTION BOTTLE, ON A TABLE WHILE VISITING MY MOTHER. WITHIN MOMENTS, MY DAUGHTER GAINED ACCESS TO THE MEDICATION. THIS NEAR-TRAGIC INCIDENT COULD HAVE BEEN AVOIDED IF I HAD KNOWN THE BOTTLE WAS NOT CHILDPROOF, AND I BELIEVE MANY PARENTS WOULD TAKE GREATER CARE IN STORING MEDICATIONS IF THEY WERE FULLY INFORMED OF THIS FACT.

RESEARCH SHOWS THAT MY CASE IS NOT ISOLATED. STUDIES CONDUCTED BY [REDACTED], AND OTHER ORGANIZATIONS DEMONSTRATE THAT CHILDREN BETWEEN THE AGES OF 3 AND 5 CAN OPEN PRESCRIPTION BOTTLES IN A MATTER OF SECONDS. SHOCKINGLY, A 2018 STUDY REVEALED THAT 50% OF PARENTS MISTAKENLY BELIEVE THAT PRESCRIPTION BOTTLES ARE CHILDPROOF, AND MANY ARE UNAWARE THAT IT TAKES MERE MOMENTS FOR SOME CHILDREN TO OPEN THESE CONTAINERS. POISON CONTROL RECEIVES OVER 500,000 CALLS ANNUALLY RELATED TO CHILDREN UNDER 5 GAINING ACCESS TO MEDICATIONS, WITH 15% OF YOUNG CHILDREN ABLE TO OPEN CHILD-RESISTANT CAPS WITHIN FIVE MINUTES. MY DAUGHTER WAS ONE OF THOSE CHILDREN.

ADDING A WARNING LABEL WOULD NOT ONLY SERVE AS A VITAL PRECAUTION FOR CONSUMERS, BUT IT WOULD ALSO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL PROTECTION FOR THE CPSC. IT OFFERS AN EXTRA LINE OF DEFENSE AND PREVENTION, ENSURING THAT PARENTS AND CAREGIVERS ARE FULLY AWARE OF THE RISK. WITHOUT THIS INFORMATION, PEOPLE MAY UNKNOWINGLY LEAVE PRESCRIPTION BOTTLES IN PLACES WHERE CHILDREN CAN REACH THEM, PUTTING YOUNG LIVES IN JEOPARDY. 

IF DESIGNING TRULY CHILDPROOF BOTTLES IS NOT IMMEDIATELY FEASIBLE, THEN A WARNING LABEL IS AN ESSENTIAL STEP TO PREVENT FURTHER INCIDENTS LIKE MINE. I IMPLORE YOU TO CONSIDER THIS REQUEST WITH THE UTMOST URGENCY. AS A PARENT WHO NEARLY FACED A DEVASTATING OUTCOME, I BELIEVE THAT EVEN THE SMALLEST PRECAUTION CAN MAKE A LIFE-SAVING DIFFERENCE.
