incident_description:
I AM WRITING TO REPORT A SERIOUS INJURY CAUSED BY A PRODUCT SOLD AT CLAIR'S STORE AS PART OF THEIR PIERCING OFFERINGS.  MY 10 YEAR OLD DAUGHTER ENDED UP IN THE EMERGENCY ROOM ON 08/04/24 AFTER ONE OF THE EARRINGS THAT WERE PLACED AT A CLAIR'S STORES ENDED UP STUCK INSIDE HER EARLOBE.  HERE IS THE TIMELINE OF EVENTS THAT LED TO THIS INCIDENT. 

MY DAUGHTER [REDACTED] HAD HER EARS PIERCED ON JULY 2ND AT A CLAIR'S STORE AT THE BLOCK IN ORANGE IN CALIFORNIA.  THE PIERCING PROCEDURE ITSELF WENT WELL AND DID NOT CAUSE ANY PROBLEMS.  
HOWEVER, AFTER WEARING THE EARRINGS FOR A MONTH AND FOLLOWING CLAIR'S AFTER CARE PROCEDURE, WE ATTEMPTED TO TAKE THE EARRINGS OFF.  [REDACTED] HAD BEEN WEARING THE EARRINGS FOR OVER ONE MONTH AT THAT POINT.  AUGUST 4, WE ATTEMPTED TO REMOVE THE STUD EARRINGS.  THE FIRST ONE CAME OUT OK.  THE SECOND ONE ON HER LEFT EAR (FACING HER) WAS EXTREMELY TIGHT AND WHEN WE TRIED PULL THE TWO EARRING PIECES APART, THE RIME STONE PART) FRONT OF EARRING) LOGGED INTO HER EARLOBE.  
WE HAD TO TAKE HER TO THE EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATELY AS SHE WAS IN A LOT OF PAIN DUE TO THE EARRING/RIME STONE (FRONT PIECE OF EARRING) BEING STUCK IN HER EARLOBE.
WE FIRST TOOK HER TO URGENT CARE BUT DOCTOR COULD NOT REMOVE WITHOUT JUST NUMBING GEL ON HER EAR.  THE PAIN WAS TOO UNBEARABLE FOR MY DAUGHTER WHEN DOCTOR TRIED TO PUSH EARING OUT.  URGENT CARE THEN SENT US TO ER.  AT THE ER, THE ER DOCTOR HAD TO GIVE HER THREE SHOTS TO NUMB HER EAR, AND THEN WAS FINALLY ABLE TO REMOVE THE EARRING.
IN LOOKING AT THE EARRINGS, I NOTICED THAT THE QUALITY OF THIS EARRINGS IS TERRIBLE AND SHOULD NOT BE OFFERED TO KIDS THAT JUST HAVE HAD THEIR EARS PIERCED. THE EARRING CAUSING THE ISSUE WAS WAY TOO TIGHT WHERE THE TWO PARTS (BACK PIECE AND THE "PIN PART" OF THE EARRING COME TOGETHER), THE "EARRING BACK PIECE" BARELY MOVES ON THE "NEEDLE PIECE".  THE SIZE OF THE RIME STONE IS VERY SMALL.  THE COMBINATION OF THESE TWO ISSUES CAN EASILY CAUSE THE EARRING TO GET LODGED IN AN EARLOBE, ESPECIALLY IF STILL TENDER AFTER PIERCING.  I WENT BACK TO ANOTHER CLAIR'S STORE AND LOOKED AT SEVERAL STUD EARRINGS AND THEY ALL HAD THE SAME ISSUE OF THE TWO PIECES BEING VERY TIGHT TOGETHER AND THE BACK PIECE NOT BEING VERY MOVABLE ON THE PIN.  THIS EVENT WAS VERY TRAUMATIC ON MY DAUGHTER AS WELL AS MYSELF.  THESE CLAIR'S EARRINGS ARE NOT SAFE AND SHOULD NOT BE OFFERED TO ANY OTHER CONSUMER, ESPECIALLY NOT CHILDREN!

**PRODUCT NAME**:DYSON AIRWRAP  
**MANUFACTURER**: DYSON

I HAVE EXPERIENCED REPEATED SAFETY ISSUES WITH THE DYSON AIRWRAP, SPECIFICALLY WITH TWO ROUND BRUSH ATTACHMENTS. THE ATTACHMENT PRONGS, WHICH APPEAR TO BE MADE OF PLASTIC, LOSE THEIR SHAPE AFTER THE PRODUCT HEATS UP DURING USE. AS A RESULT, THE ATTACHMENTS NO LONGER SECURELY LOCK ONTO THE MACHINE AND EVENTUALLY DISLODGE. THIS ISSUE FIRST OCCURRED WITH MY ORIGINAL ROUND BRUSH ATTACHMENT, WHICH COMPLETELY DISLODGED MULTIPLE TIMES AFTER LOSING ITS LOCKING POWER. I HAD THIS ATTACHMENT REPLACED AFTER DOZENS OF FAILURES.

HOWEVER, THE REPLACEMENT ATTACHMENT, WHICH I RECEIVED ABOUT TWO TO THREE MONTHS AGO, IS ALREADY EXPERIENCING THE SAME PROBLEM. IT FREQUENTLY BECOMES LOOSE DURING USE, DESPITE MY EFFORTS TO BE CAUTIOUS. ON A RECENT OCCASION, THE ATTACHMENT COMPLETELY DISLODGED FROM THE MACHINE WHILE IT WAS IN USE, CAUSING A SIGNIFICANT SAFETY HAZARD. THE ATTACHMENT FLEW OFF AND BURNED MY CHIN, AS IT WAS EXTREMELY HOT. 

THIS PRESENTS A SERIOUS RISK OF INJURY. I AM FORTUNATE THAT IT ONLY HIT ME, AS MY YOUNG DAUGHTER WAS NEARBY, AND IT COULD HAVE EASILY FLOWN OFF AND HIT HER INSTEAD.

THE ISSUE SEEMS TO LIE WITH THE MATERIAL OF THE ATTACHMENT PRONGS AND THE LOCKING MECHANISM OF THE MACHINE, WHICH FAIL TO FUNCTION PROPERLY AFTER EXTENDED USE, PARTICULARLY WHEN EXPOSED TO HEAT. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR SERIOUS HARM, I BELIEVE THIS PRODUCT PRESENTS A SAFETY RISK AND NEEDS FURTHER INVESTIGATION.

I OWN A TABLE SAW MANUFACTURED BY LAGUNA TOOLS OF GRAND PRARIE, TX.  ALL TABLE SAWS MANUFACTURED SINCE 2008 ARE REQUIRED TO HAVE A SAFETY DEVICE CALLED A RIVING KNIFE, WHICH PREVENTS THE CUT PART OF THE BOARD FROM PINCHING TOGETHER AS IT IS PASSED THROUGH THE SAW.  IF THE "KERF" OR CUT PORTION OF THE BOARD PINCHES TOGETHER, IT WILL CAUSE THE SAW TO BIND, WHICH CAN LEAD TO THE BOARD BEING FORCEFULLY EJECTED BACK TOWARDS THE OPERATOR AT HIGH SPEED.  IN SOME CASES IT MAY EVEN RESULT IN THE OPERATOR'S HAND BEING DRAWN INTO THE SPINNING SAW BLADE.

THE RIVING KNIFE ON MY TABLE SAW, LAGUNA MODEL FUSION F1, HAS BECOME VERY LOOSE, CAUSING IT TO BE MISALIGNED WITH THE BLADE.  THIS SETS UP A VERY DANGEROUS OPERATING CONDITION.  WHEN I CONTACTED LAGUNA'S TECH SUPPORT, THEIR ANSWER WAS "DO NOT USE THE SAW AS IT IS DANGEROUS TO OPERATE IN THIS CONDITION."  I ASKED THEM WHAT THE FIX WAS AND WAS TOLD "TO REMOVE THE RIVING KNIFE CLAMP MECHANISM, CLEAN AND LUBRICATE IT, AND RE-INSTALL IT."  I ASKED HOW I MIGHT GO ABOUT DOING THAT AND WAS TOLD "WE DON'T HAVE A PUBLISHED PROCEDURE BECAUSE IT IS STRAIGHT FORWARD."  I PRESSED FURTHER ON WHAT THE PROCEDURE WAS FOR DOING WHAT THEY SUGGESTED AND GOT NO ANSWER, OTHER THAN TO SUGGEST THAT "I AM THE FIRST PERSON TO EVER HAVE A PROBLEM WITH THIS."  I HOLD A DEGREE IN MECHANICAL ENGINEERING AND AM QUITE FAMILIAR WITH TOOLS AND MACHINERY, AND I CAN SAY THAT THERE IS ABSOLUTELY NOTHING SELF-EXPLANATORY OR "STRAIGHTFORWARD" ABOUT PERFORMING THIS REPAIR.  THEY ARE SETTING UP AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS CONDITION WITH A TABLE SAW THAT THEY MANUFACTURE, AND ARE BEING EXTREMELY NEGLIGENT ABOUT ADDRESSING MY CONCERN.
